So you were convicted of having good taste.

I still haven't figured out why that one's a crime.

column1:
You've maintained your innocence from the beginning. I believe you.

 A young man in a guard's uniform steps up to the bars and begins fumbling with a keyring.

 "My name is Greave. I thought I was coming here to keep people safe, but the other guards are thugs. They don't care who deserves to be here and who doesn't. I'm getting out of here, but there's no way I'm leaving an innocent person in this pit."

 The door clicks open, and Greave looks straight at you.

 "This might be a bit rough. You got any experience with a weapon or anything?"
column2:
“你从一开始就坚称自己无辜。我相信你。”

一名穿卫兵制服的年轻人走到铁栏前，开始笨手笨脚地翻弄钥匙圈。

“我叫 Greave。我本以为来这儿是为了保护人，可其他卫兵都是暴徒。他们才不管谁该待在这儿、谁不该。我要离开这儿，但绝不会把一个无辜的人留在这个坑里。”

门锁咔哒一声打开，Greave 直直看着你。

“接下来可能会有点难。你用过武器之类的吗？”

column1:
Peering into the bars through a wild shock of hair is the wry face of a young orc. He begins to work the lock open quietly.

"Name's Kirilo. I escaped a while back, but I saw the boat come in, and... well I remember sitting in one of these cells myself, just wishing someone would come and help."

The lock quietly snaps open and the door goes slack. Kirilo, barefoot and dressed in scant more than tatters and a ragged cloak, pushes it open and motions you out into the hall.

"Now the fun starts. You got any tricks up your sleeve I should know about?"
column2:
一头乱蓬蓬的头发后面，一张年轻兽人带着坏笑的脸从铁栏间探了进来。他开始悄无声息地开锁。

“我叫 Kirilo。我前些日子逃出来了，可我看见船靠了岸，就……我还记得自己坐在这种牢房里，巴望着有人来帮一把。”

锁轻轻弹开，门松了。Kirilo 光着脚，身上差不多只剩破布和一件破烂斗篷。他推开门，示意你到走廊里来。

“好戏现在才开场。你袖子里藏着什么本事，是我该知道的？”

column1:
Well at least you're smart enough not to shit me.

A man the size of an ox steps up to the bars and begins to struggle with the lock.

"Some of the guards thought it'd be fun to take me out of the cell for a little sport, but now they're fuckin' dead, and I got their boots. And the key to your cell, 'parently."

The lock clicks open, and he wastes no time throwing the door wide. He's been stripped, but has a hastily-gathered pack of things, presumably scavenged from the guards he killed.

"Call me Leftie. And tell me you can fight, cuz I ain't fucking carrying you."
column2:
“至少你还算聪明，没跟老子扯淡。”

一个壮得像头牛的男人走到铁栏前，开始跟锁较劲。

“有的卫兵觉得把我弄出牢房取乐很好玩，可现在他们他妈的死了，靴子归我。还有你牢房的钥匙，看样子是。”

锁咔哒打开，他立刻把门甩开。他被扒光了，但匆忙收拾了一包东西，想必是从他杀掉的那些卫兵身上搜来的。

“叫我 Leftie。跟我说你会打架，老子他妈可不背你。”

column1:
A mountainous orc with a bald head and a neatly-trimmed beard steps up to the bars and begins quietly undoing the lock.

"I am called Nazar, friend. I broke into this place looking for someone, but all I found was this key, and I don't like leaving empty-handed. Lucky for you!"

The door clicks open, and Nazar stands before you, olive-skinned, barrel-chested, and fur-clad.

"You can thank me later. For now, we have to get out of here, and I can't promise it'll be easy. Can you fight if we need to?"
column2:
一个山一样高大的兽人走到铁栏前，光头，胡子修得整整齐齐，开始悄无声息地开锁。

“我叫 Nazar，朋友。我闯到这儿是来找人的，可只找到了这把钥匙。我不喜欢空手离开。算你走运！”

门锁咔哒打开，Nazar 站在你面前，橄榄色的皮肤，胸膛厚实，身披毛皮。

“谢我的话以后再说。眼下我们得离开这儿，我不敢保证会容易。要是得动手，你能打吗？”

column1:
An athletic man with a bandana tied over his forehead steps up to the bars and begins silently working the lock open. He has a broad grin, but his eyebrows are covered so his expression is difficult to read.

"I broke in to raid their supplies, but they ain't got shit right now. Saw this key on the desk though, and thought a prison break sounded like fun. You agree, of course."

Quiet as a whisper, the door swings open. The man is clearly an accomplished burglar, and seems dressed for the occasion.

"I'm Peregrine, by the way. Ready to roll?"
column2:
一个精瘦的男人走到铁栏前，额头上系着头巾，开始无声地开锁。他咧嘴笑得很开，可眉毛被挡住了，表情难以捉摸。

“我闯进来是想抢他们的补给，可他们现在屁都没有。不过我在桌子上看见了这把钥匙，觉得越狱听着挺带劲。你当然同意。”

门开得像一声耳语。这人显然是个老练的盗贼，而且这身打扮正适合这种场合。

“顺便说一句，我是 Peregrine。可以开溜了？”

column1:
Wait, an actual necromancer? I didn't think-

The man's voice is cut off in a strangled cry, as he is slammed against the bars by a gigantic, nearly naked man the size of an ox. In the space of just a few moments, the large man breaks the smaller one's neck, then searches his body. Finding nothing to his liking, he takes the dead man's boots and leaves.

You stand and peer through the bars and see the key, presumably to your cell, on the floor just a few feet away.

The opportunity could not be better. With a simple incantation, you sieze on the moment of the guard's death to push his corpse into unlife and bind it to your will, unlocking the door and releasing you.

You gather yourself and set forth.
column2:
“等等，真是个死灵术士？我没想到——”

男人的声音变成一声被掐住的惨叫。一个几乎全裸、壮得像头牛的巨人把他撞在铁栏上。短短片刻，大个子就拧断了那个较小男人的脖子，然后搜他的身。没找到中意的东西，便拿走死者的靴子，离开了。

你站起来，透过铁栏望去，看见那把钥匙——想必是开你牢房的——就在几步外的地上。

时机再好不过。你念一段简单的咒文，抓住这名卫兵死去的瞬间，把他的尸体推进不死，缚在你的意志上，打开门锁，放自己出来。

你定了定神，向前走去。

column1:
A sprightly young woman with a full head of auburn curls steps up to the bars and begins to work the lock.

"You know, I've broken out of a few prisons in my time, but I've got a good feeling about this one. The guards are all morons, as far as I can tell. Also, hi. I'm Rosaline. Come with?"

She pushes the door open as the lock clicks, and motions you out into the hallway. She has the look of a dancer, but it's clear that right now, she isn't fooling around.

"Well, ready to go? Oh wait, please don't tell me that I rescued a baker or something. You can fight or at least hide or something, yeah?"
column2:
一个脚步轻快的年轻女人走到铁栏前，一头浓密的赤褐色卷发，开始开锁。

“你知道吗，我这辈子逃出过几座监狱，可我对这座感觉很好。据我看，这儿的卫兵全是蠢货。对了，你好。我是 Rosaline。一起来？”

锁一响，她推开门，示意你到走廊里。她看着像个舞者，可这会儿显然不是在闹着玩。

“那么，准备走了吗？哦等等，可别告诉我我救出来的是个面包师之类的。你会打，或者至少会躲，对吧？”

column1:
A man with grizzled hair and a dour expression steps up to the bars and begins to unlock the door.

"I'm Shapiro, a sorcerer. I managed to snag a few keys from the guard as he passed by my cell, but there's no telling how long it'll be before they discover something is amiss."

The door swings open gently as the lock is undone. Shapiro is dressed in what must have once have been a grand magister's robe, now soiled and tattered, and he looks very tired.

"We don't have much time, and we'll need some kind of strategy. I can cast some simple spells. What should I expect of you?"
column2:
一个头发花白、神情阴沉的男人走到铁栏前，开始开锁。

“我是 Shapiro，一名巫师。卫兵经过我牢房的时候，我设法摸走了几把钥匙，但说不准他们多久会发现出事了。”

锁一开，门轻轻荡开。Shapiro 穿着一件想必曾经华丽的魔导师长袍，如今又脏又破，他看上去非常疲惫。

“我们时间不多，得有点办法。我会施几道简单的法术。我该指望你什么？”

column1:
A very tall orc with a long and well-kept beard steps up to the bars and gets to work unlocking your cell.

"I am Vankan, stranger. I've been here quite some time, but I took advantage of the commotion of the new arrivals to steal some keys. I got the one for my cell, and apparently the one for yours."

The lock clicks and the door swings open, and you can see that Vankan has made an attempt to make himself presentable, despite being clothed in tattered furs.

"And now, we're both free. Comparitively, anyway. We've still got to get out of the compound. I can cast a few spells if you... what do you do, exactly?"
column2:
一个身材很高的兽人走到铁栏前，留着一把修剪整齐的长胡子，开始开你的牢房锁。

“我是 Vankan，陌生人。我在这儿待了不少日子了，趁新来的人那阵乱，偷了几把钥匙。我拿到了自己牢房的，看样子还有你的。”

锁一响，门荡开。看得出 Vankan 努力让自己像样一点，尽管他穿的是破烂毛皮。

“现在，我们都自由了。相对来说，反正是。可我们还得离开这片监区。你要是需要，我会施几道法术……你到底是干什么的？”

column1:
You, then, are the one I have been seeking!

A clawed hand reaches into the bars and peels the door from its hinges. On the other side stands a creature that can only be a demon from the pit of hell. He is the size of lean man, but his skin has the color and sheen of an open wound, and his grinning face is crowned with sharp horns.

"Your call has been answered, and I, Zantanak, have come to serve."

He bows and presents the hallway to you as any gracious host might, before standing straight and brandishing a horribly jagged spear.

"There yet remain fools blocking the way. Are you well enough to fight?"
column2:
“那么，你就是我一直在找的那个人！”

一只带爪的手伸进铁栏，把门从铰链上撕了下来。另一边站着一个只能是地狱深坑里来的恶魔。他身量像个精瘦的男人，皮肤的颜色和光泽却像一道敞开的伤口，那张咧嘴笑着的脸上顶着尖角。

“你的召唤已得到回应。我，Zantanak，前来效命。”

他鞠躬，像任何殷勤的主人那样把走廊让给你，然后站直，举起一杆锯齿狰狞的长矛。

“路上还有蠢货挡着。你的身子撑得住动手吗？”

Over the next few days, you are taken by boat to the island of Lukatt. 

An angry wind whips heavy rain as you are put on a lifeboat with another man in chains and jettisoned some distance from the shore. 

The current carries you rapidly toward a short cove where men in guards' uniforms wait to receive you. You, then, are the one I have been seeking!

A clawed hand reaches into the bars, and, grasping the edge of the door's small window tightly, rips the door from its hinges with a thunderous crash, tossing it aside as if it were nothing. 

On the other side stands a creature that can only be a demon from the pit of hell. He is the size of lean man, but his skin has the color and sheen of an open wound, and his grinning face is crowned with sharp horns.

"Your call has been answered, and I, Zantanak, have come to serve you, to honor your contract. Let us quit this place, as you have commanded."

He bows and presents the hallway to you as any gracious host might, before standing straight and brandishing a horribly jagged spear.

"There yet remain fools blocking the way. Are you well enough to fight?"

Logus 带你来到一处隐蔽的小海湾，平静的水面上停泊着一艘气派的纵帆船。

装了一天的补给、把船准备妥当之后，你的船员把船划进平静的浅滩，Logus 下令起航，驶向兽人国度察拉思。

风鼓起船帆，海岸越来越远，你终于把这座被遗弃的卢卡特岛甩在了身后。

column1:
Against such a mighty squall, there is little you can do but watch.

The ship shudders as it is dashed against something solid, and purchase flies out from beneath your feet. You drift through the rain for what feels like forever.

A flash of angry lightning decimates the main mast, and you catch a glimpse of Logus' red coat fluttering as he too is thrown skyward.

Then, your body crashes hard against the water, and all is darkness.
column2:
面对如此狂暴的风暴，你几乎什么也做不了，只能眼睁睁看着。

船身猛地一震，撞上了什么坚硬的东西，你脚下的落脚点一下子飞了出去。你在雨里飘了很久，久得仿佛没有尽头。

一道暴怒的闪电劈碎了主桅，你瞥见 Logus 的红外套在翻飞，他自己也被甩上了天空。

随后，你的身体重重砸进水里，一切陷入黑暗。

column1:
You scramble up the sloping chute in the darkness as the water continues to slowly rise behind you.

The climb is difficult in the dark, but gradually, the sound of water fades further behind, and the stale, dank air gives way to a cool draft.

A moment of searching reveals a crack of moonlight shining through some loosely piled stones.

Carefully, you pry some of the stones loose, and manage to make a hole big enough to squeeze through.
column2:
你在黑暗中沿着倾斜的槽道往上爬，身后的水还在缓缓上涨。

黑暗里攀爬十分艰难，但渐渐地，水声越来越远，陈腐阴湿的空气也换成了一股凉风。

摸索了一会儿，你发现一缕月光从几块松松堆着的石头缝里透了出来。

你小心地撬松几块石头，终于弄出了一个能挤过去的洞。

column1:
You have come out at the base of a rough seaside cliff face. The ocean has become calm once again, and the sky is clear and bright, nearly blinding after your trek through the dark tunnels.

There are several small fires on a rocky beach in the distance, hopefully other survivors of your band.

You make your way down to the beach and toward them.
column2:
你钻出来的地方，是一处粗糙的海边崖壁脚下。大海重又平静，天空晴朗明亮，在你穿过那些黑暗隧道之后，亮得几乎刺眼。

远处的岩石滩上有几处小火堆，但愿是你的团伙里其他的幸存者。

你下到海滩，朝他们走去。

column1:
When you arrive, you find Zantanak and the others, and he seems unsurprised. "Welcome back, Master," he says, bowing. "As you can see, most of your soldiers have survived. Some are injured, but it is nothing serious."

"The creature that did this was Leviathan. I knew of his presence here, but thought it unlikely that he would interfere with your escape. It is most curious."

You share your account of the strange temple you found in the grotto, and Zantanak nods his head in understanding.

"Yes, it would stand to reason that the ancient Lukattites worshipped Leviathan as a kind of God. He is undoubtedly a being of tremendous power, and obviously is aware of our movements, but the question remains as to why he would interfere. I do not have the answers."
column2:
你到达时，看见了 Zantanak 和其他人，他似乎并不惊讶。“欢迎回来，主人，”他鞠躬说道。“如你所见，你的士兵大多都活了下来。有人受了伤，但都不严重。”

“做下这件事的生物是 Leviathan。我知道他就在这一带，但没想到他会阻挠你逃跑。这非常古怪。”

你讲了自己在洞窟里发现的那座奇怪神殿，Zantanak 点头表示明白。

“是的，这就说得通了：古代卢卡特人把 Leviathan 当作某种神来崇拜。他无疑是一个力量惊人的存在，而且显然清楚我们的动向，可问题仍然是，他为什么要插手。我没有答案。”

column1: For a long moment, you feel as if you are being unmade, and your vision fades to darkness. \n\nThe voices of your companions drift off into the ether.
column2: 有那么漫长的一瞬间，你感觉自己正在被从世上抹去，视野渐渐沉入黑暗。\n\n你同伴们的声音飘散进了以太之中。

column1:
Ribbons of pallid light drift past as a great expanse of churning darkness yawns open before you. 

As if guided by an invisible current, you drift toward a black knot of something solid fading into your vision. 

A castle, set adrift in the great nothing.
column2:
惨白的光带从身旁飘过，一大片翻涌的黑暗在你面前裂开了巨口。

仿佛被一股无形的暗流牵引，你漂向一团正在视野里渐渐显形的漆黑之物。

一座城堡，漂在这片巨大的虚无之中。

column1: You drift nearer still, and your feet gently make contact with the ground. \n\nWherever this is, it seems the only way to go is to venture inside.
column2: 你又漂近了些，双脚轻轻触到了地面。\n\n不管这是什么地方，看来唯一的去路就是走进去。

column1:
With your bargain struck, you emerge from the bath and rejoin the rest of your band. 

In the weeks that follow, fortune favours you most heavily, giving you the weather you need when you need it, and plaguing your enemies with hordes of monsters that give you a wide berth. Your larders overflow and your people are comfortable. 

There can be no question that some unseen hand guides your movements, and as word spreads and your influence and numbers grow, you eventually come to be known far and wide as the one destined to rule over Lukatt.
column2:
交易达成之后，你从浴池里出来，回到了团伙的其他人那里。

接下来的几周里，好运格外眷顾你：你需要什么样的天气，就有什么样的天气；成群的怪物去纠缠你的敌人，却对你退避三舍。你的粮仓满得装不下，你的人也过得安稳。

毫无疑问，有一只看不见的手在引导你的行动。随着消息传开，你的影响力和人数不断增长，你最终远近闻名，成了那个注定要统治卢卡特的人。

column1:
As you begin taking more and more territory across the island, Frico becomes aggressive, and tries to have you assassinated. 

Your fortune, however, holds fast, and the attempt fails. Eventually, seeing no other choice, you mount a full assault on Frico's castle, and he is killed by your soldiers.

For all of his posturing and politicking, the castle holds surprisingly little of worth, revealing the vampire to be little more than a bored corpse playing at grandeur. The place is seized by your people and converted into one of your strongholds.
column2:
随着你在岛上夺取越来越多的领地，Frico 变得咄咄逼人，试图派人暗杀你。

然而你的好运纹丝不动，暗杀失败了。最终你别无选择，对 Frico 的城堡发动全面进攻，他死在了你的士兵手里。

尽管他摆尽了姿态、耍尽了权术，城堡里值钱的东西却少得惊人，揭露出这个吸血鬼不过是一具闲得发慌的尸体，在装模作样地摆出显赫的样子。这地方被你的人夺下，改造成了你的一座据点。

column1:
The lycanthropes of Hayill petition you early on, recognizing your efforts in ridding them of Frico, and pledging their support for your conquest of the island. 

In return, the Alpha asks only that his people be recognized as people, and that they will be welcomed the same as anyone else. It seems a simple enough request, and your relations with Hayill have been good, so you agree.

So long as the lycanthropes conduct themselves in a civilized manner, their lycanthropy, in and of itself, will not be an offense, and they will not have to hide from the rest of the island.
column2:
海伊尔的狼人族很早就来向你请愿。他们承认你除掉 Frico 的功劳，并承诺支持你征服全岛。

作为回报，那位 Alpha 只要求他的族人被承认为人，并且能和其他任何人一样受到欢迎。这要求似乎足够简单，而你与海伊尔的关系也一直不错，于是你同意了。

只要狼人族以文明的方式行事，仅仅身为狼人这件事本身就不再构成罪名，他们也不必再向岛上的其他人隐瞒身份。

column1:
With control over Lukatt's seas firmly in your grasp, you are able to send envoys to both the nations of Crest and Tsarath, requesting that they cease their use of the island and recognize your sovereignty. 

Tsarath's King agrees fairly readily, but the King of Crest is not pleased, and he attempts to take Lukatt by force. 

Your mastery of Lukatt's waters, of course, renders his efforts utterly useless. You are able to destroy or seize most of the enemy ships, and Crest quickly agrees to a truce.
column2:
你牢牢掌控卢卡特的海域之后，得以向克雷斯特和察拉思两国派出使者，要求他们停止使用这座岛，并承认你的主权。

察拉思的国王相当爽快地同意了，克雷斯特的国王却不高兴，试图用武力夺取卢卡特。

你对卢卡特水域的掌控当然让他的努力完全落空。你摧毁或俘获了大部分敌船，克雷斯特很快同意停战。

column1: In a short few years, the island's dangerous monsters have all but disappeared, and Lukatt becomes a bustling hub of trade replete with eager immigrants looking to build and start fresh lives. \n\nAlthough many of the island's inhabitants still bear brands upon their necks, in time these marks come to be seen as the marks of pioneers, and not of criminals; people who had, perhaps in the past made mistakes, but who struggled hard to survive and make the most of their setbacks.
column2: 短短几年间，岛上危险的怪物几乎消失殆尽，卢卡特成了一个熙熙攘攘的贸易枢纽，满是渴望建造家园、开始新生活的移民。\n\n尽管许多岛民脖子上仍留着烙印，日子久了，这些印记渐渐被视为开拓者的标记，而不再是罪犯的标记。这些人或许过去犯过错，但他们拼死求生，尽力从挫折里走出一条路。

column1:
Reluctant to fall into the same pattern that resigned so many people to the island in the first place, your application of law is basic, with a small, publicly elected court that oversees only the most severe forms of crime. 

A great deal of autonomy is given to individual communities to carry out justice in the ways they feel best fit their people, and the island is soon divided into counties, each following slightly different models of law, some more resembling those of Crest, some resembling those of Tsarath, and some a unique mixture of both. 

Most immigrants are able to find a community in which they can feel safe and comfortable, and though the mixture of laws can be confusing for some, the island attracts a wide range of interesting and diverse people.
column2:
你不愿重蹈覆辙，再用当初把那么多人打发到这座岛上的那套做法，因此法律从简：只设一个小型的民选法庭，只管最严重的罪行。

各个社区得到很大的自主权，可以按他们觉得最适合自己人的方式施行正义。岛屿很快划分出若干个郡，各自遵循略有不同的法律，有的更像克雷斯特，有的更像察拉思，有的则是两者独有的混合。

大多数移民都能找到一个让自己觉得安全、自在的社区。法律混杂，有些人会觉得困惑，但这座岛还是吸引了各式各样有趣的人。

column1:
Thoroughly unsettled by your encounter with heavy-handed justice, your laws are minimal, and communities are left to mostly fend for themselves.

The island still has a large criminal population, and is widely seen as a land where the convicted can find a second chance at life. This frontier-style governance scares off many who might otherwise find the island attractive, but it means that your population consists of only the hardiest and the bravest, and your people gain a reputation as such. 

Lukatt makes an exciting destination for would-be adventurers and treasure hunters, eager to delve into the countless ruins where monsters still dwell, and submerge themselves in history, gold, or blood.
column2:
你被自己遭遇的那种下手极重的司法彻底搅得不安，于是法律少到不能再少，各个社区大多只得自己顾自己。

岛上仍然有大量罪犯，外界也普遍把它看作定罪之人可以寻求第二次生命机会的地方。这种边疆式的治理吓跑了许多本来可能觉得这岛有吸引力的人，但也意味着你的人口只由最坚韧、最勇敢的人组成，而你的人民也因此得了这样的名声。

卢卡特成了准冒险者和寻宝者眼中令人兴奋的去处。他们渴望深入无数仍有怪物栖息的遗迹，一头扎进历史、黄金，或者鲜血。

column1:
You are careful to clearly and fairly spell out the new laws of the land, ensuring that fair, elected courts handle criminal issues, and that everything is carefully recorded and reviewed, with punishments commeasurate to crimes and equal treatment for men, orcs, and natives alike. 

Some rankle under these laws, but you work hard to ensure that they are applied as evenly as possible, and most of the people immigrating from the other nations find the adjustment to be quite straightforward. 

Though some would say that you wasted an opportunity to embrace a new, freer way of life, nobody argues that your reign is not fair.
column2:
你小心地把这片土地的新法律写得清楚而公平，确保由公正的民选法庭处理刑事事务，一切都仔细记录、加以复核，刑罚与罪行相称，人类、兽人和原住民一视同仁。

有些人因此耿耿于怀，但你努力让这些法律尽可能不偏不倚地施行，而从其他国家迁来的大多数人觉得适应起来相当顺利。

尽管有人会说，你浪费了拥抱一种更自由的新生活的机会，但没有人认为你的统治不公平。

column1:
Once the immigrants began arriving, Bato became swept up in the rebuilding effort. 

 He always preferred routine labour to combat, so he eventually signed on with a group of people heading out to set up a camp in the lower Knightwood region.

The last you heard from him, he is still there, building homes for new immigrants and keeping himself quite busy.
column2:
移民一开始到来，Bato 就一头扎进了重建。

他一向更喜欢日常劳作，而不是打仗，所以最终跟一群人一起，去骑士林靠下的一带扎营。

你最后一次得到他的消息时，他还在那儿给新移民盖房子，把自己忙得不可开交。

column1:
Bato was excited about the rebuilding of the island before the conquest of it was even completed.

For a while, he regularly came to you with revision upon revision for a plan to renovate the capital city of old Lukatt, and when you finally had the whole of the island under your control and gave him the go-ahead, he actually wept openly.

With his efforts, the capital became a respectable seat for your new nation, and Bato now handles the rebuilding efforts in an official capacity, managing the shipments of supplies, brokering trade deals, and negotiating with foreign guilds for material and labour.

He remains stalwart, reliable, and your close friend.
column2:
甚至在征服完成之前，Bato 就对重建这座岛兴奋不已。

有一段时间，他隔三差五来找你，把翻修旧卢卡特首都的计划改了一版又一版。等你终于控制了整座岛、准他动手时，他居然当着你的面哭了出来。

经他这么一弄，首都成了你这个新国家体面的都城，而 Bato 如今以正式身份掌管重建：调度补给的运送，撮合贸易，并与外国行会交涉材料和劳力。

他依然坚定、可靠，仍是你的挚友。

column1:
Beauregard was particularly overwhelmed by all of the changes sweeping over the island. 

When word got out that he was a survivor from old Lukatt, and that he was several hundred years old, he began to be harassed by people calling themselves historians; people who didn't like the way their accounts of Lukatt's history differed from his, and one day he simply disappeared.

His whereabouts are unknown.
column2:
席卷全岛的变化让 Beauregard 尤其不知所措。

消息传开，说他是旧卢卡特的幸存者，而且已经几百岁了，自称为历史学家的人便开始纠缠他。那些人不喜欢自己笔下的卢卡特历史和他的说法对不上。有一天，他干脆消失了。

他的下落无人知晓。

column1:
Beauregard was particularly overwhelmed by all of the changes sweeping over the island, and often came to you for advice and guidance.

Knowing that he was once a military officer, you appointed him as a general in charge of rebuilding new Lukatt's military.

At first, he was shocked, but he didn't want to disappoint you, and having a familiar responsibility to focus on seemed to give him some purpose. He eventually began to shed his doubts and find his feet once more.

Now, General Beauregard lives at Spartill Lodge, but he is often at your side and at your table, advising you on military and tactical matters, and offering you and the new nation the same support you once offered him.
column2:
席卷全岛的变化让 Beauregard 尤其不知所措，他常常来向你寻求建议和指引。

你知道他曾经是军官，便任命他为将军，负责重建新卢卡特的军队。

起初他很震惊，但他不想让你失望，而有一份熟悉的职责可以专注，似乎也给了他一些目标。他最终开始放下疑虑，重新站稳了脚跟。

如今，Beauregard 将军住在斯帕蒂尔旅舍，但他常常伴在你身侧、坐在你的席上，为你提供军事和战术上的建议，并把你曾经给予他的支持，同样献给你和这个新国家。

column1:
Borfalgor disappeared when the first boat of immigrants arrived.

Though it's possible that he simply retreated to watch the island's progress from a distance, you have heard some reports that he stowed away on the ship as it returned to the mainland.

You can't be certain, but he is probably exploring on his own, seeing more sights than any goblin ever has before.
column2:
第一艘移民的船抵达时，Borfalgor 消失了。

他有可能只是退到远处，观望这座岛的进展，但你也听到一些说法，说他藏在那艘船上，跟着回了大陆。

你无法确定，不过他大概是在独自探索，见到的景象比从前任何一个哥布林都多。

column1:
When it became obvious that marauding goblin tribes were a threat to the burgeoning civilization, Borfalgor offered to head the effort to get them under control. He seemed convinced that they could be confined to their own lands without exterminating them, and wanted to try.

The effort, however, did not go well, and he has since given up on trying to bridge the gap between the goblins and the rest of civilization.

He currently wanders the island, sending you regular reports regarding monster populations and rebuilding progress. He promises to return soon, once he feels like he has a proper grasp on his place in the world.
column2:
当四处劫掠的哥布林部落显然威胁到了新兴的文明时，Borfalgor 提出由他来负责把他们控制住。他似乎确信，不必灭绝他们，也能把他们限制在自己的土地上，并且想试试。

然而事情进展并不顺利，他此后便放弃了弥合哥布林与其余文明之间那道鸿沟的尝试。

他目前在岛上四处游荡，定期向你送来关于怪物数量和重建进度的报告。他答应，等自己觉得真正把握住了在这世上的位置，就很快回来。

column1:
Though Borgnina generally approved of the changes made on the island, she was always more than a little wary about your encounter with Leviathan.

She never asked you about it directly, but you frequently got the sense that she was unhappy, and one day she told you that her pilgrimage was over, and that she was leaving.

"Be careful," she warned as she turned to leave for the last time. "Remember what happened to Glamig. Don't follow her."

Then she was gone, and you have not seen her again.
column2:
尽管 Borgnina 大体上认可岛上的变革，她对你与 Leviathan 的遭遇却始终相当戒备。

她从未直接问过你，但你常常觉得她并不高兴。有一天，她告诉你，她的朝圣结束了，她要离开。

“小心，”她最后一次转身离去时警告道。“记住 Glamig 的下场。别步她的后尘。”

然后她就走了，你再也没有见过她。

column1:
Borgnina seemed to only grow more confident as time passed, devoting herself entirely to shepherding the soul of the new nation rising up around her.

Because she was never actually reprimanded or excommunicated from her old order, the completion of her seemingly impossible pilgrimage became widely regarded as a divine miracle, and she was soon granted station enough to outrank the men who once tried to drive her to ruin.

Under her gentle guidance, a chapter of crusaders was established on the island, and they made it their personal quest to rediscover and rebuild shrines of worship across the land.

When he speaks to you, Leviathan tells you that he hears your people whisper their thanks to him far and wide, and he seems pleased by this.
column2:
随着时间过去，Borgnina 似乎只变得更加自信，把全部身心用来牧养在她身边崛起的这个新国家的灵魂。

由于她从未真正受到旧修会的斥责，也没有被革出教门，她完成这场看似不可能的朝圣，被广泛视为神迹。不久，她的地位便高到足以压过那些曾经试图把她逼上绝路的男人。

在她温和的引导下，岛上成立了一个十字军分会，他们把重新找到并重建散落各地的礼拜圣所当成了自己的使命。

Leviathan 对你说话时告诉你，他听见你的人民在四面八方低声向他道谢，他对此似乎很高兴。

column1:
Byrne stayed close to you after things on the island began to move quickly, seemingly afraid that he would be caught up in the purge of monsters. 

Though you reassured him of his safety repeatedly, he grew more and more paranoid, sequestering himself away for days on end.

Eventually, due to his irregular feeding, he went berzerk and attacked some travelers. By the time you heard about it, he had already been hunted down and killed by a vigilante adventurer.

This has, of course, done little to improve the opinion of the populace regarding vampires, and reports of them on the island are becoming more and more scarce.
column2:
岛上的事态开始迅速推进之后，Byrne 一直紧挨着你，似乎害怕自己会被卷进对怪物的清洗。

尽管你反复向他保证他是安全的，他还是越来越偏执，一连好几天把自己关起来。

最终，由于没能规律地进食，他发狂了，袭击了一些旅人。等你听到消息时，他已经被一名自行执法的冒险者追杀并杀死。

这当然没让民众对吸血鬼的看法好上多少，岛上关于他们的消息也越来越少。

column1:
Byrne seemed unsure of himself after the island's conquest was completed, afraid of his hunger and afraid that a purge of dangerous monsters might include him.

In order to assuage his fears, you appointed Byrne as a dignitary, to be your point of contact with any communities of cooperative monsters still remaining on the island, and found him a personal cook who would be unafraid to get creative with including blood in the food.

He immediately took to both, and now spends his days traveling the island with his entourage, swaddled in finery, and brokering alliances and contracts with those people less inclined to the light of day.

He remains your friend, still reporting to you and frequently attending your events, and perhaps ironically, looking more the part of a vampire lord than ever before.
column2:
征服完成之后，Byrne 似乎对自己没什么把握，既害怕自己的饥饿，也害怕对危险怪物的清洗会把他也包括进去。

为了安抚他，你任命 Byrne 为使节，让他充当你与岛上仍然剩下的、愿意合作的怪物群落之间的联络人，还给他配了一名私人厨师，对方不怕在饭菜里变着法子加进血。

两件事他都立刻喜欢上了。如今他带着随从在岛上各处走动，一身华服，与那些不爱见光的人谈盟约、立契约。

他仍然是你的朋友，依旧向你汇报，也常常出席你的场合；说来也许有些讽刺，他看上去比以往任何时候都更像一位吸血鬼领主。

column1:
With the seas calm once more, Logus was eager to return to the water. 

You appointed him Captain of one of the ships you seized from the Crest attacks, and he has been working supply lanes to Tsarath ever since.

Although you still do not know him very well, he makes an effort to check in with you at the capital every so often, and he seems happy to have a crew of his own once again.
column2:
海上重又平静之后，Logus 急着回到水上。

你任命他为船长，让他指挥从克雷斯特来犯的船队里缴获的一艘船。此后，他一直在经营通往察拉思的补给航线。

尽管你到现在还不算很了解他，他仍会隔一阵子就到首都来见你，而且似乎很高兴又能有一支自己的船员。

column1:
Logus was anxious to get back out to the water once he knew it would be safe, but he seemed reluctant to just abandon you to the island. Seeing an opportunity for a compromise, you appointed him Admiral of Lukatt's navy.

He tearfully and graciously accepted the offer, and worked hard to oversee the rebuilding of just such a navy.

He spends more time in port than at sea, but he makes a point of captaining each new ship's maiden voyage and reporting to you in person on just how well the efforts are going.

Admiral Logus remains a wise, available advisor, and a good friend.
column2:
Logus 一得知海上重归安全，就急着想回到水上，但他似乎又不忍心就这么把你丢在岛上。你看准了折中的机会，任命他为卢卡特海军上将。

他热泪盈眶、感激不尽地接受了任命，并兢兢业业地督导重建这样一支海军。

他待在港口的时间比出海还多，但每艘新船的处女航他都坚持亲自担任船长，回来后再当面向你汇报各项工作进展得如何。

Logus 上将始终是一位睿智、随叫随到的顾问，也是一位好朋友。

column1:
As your conquest of the island became inevitable, Grant returned to Hayill, and eventually became your point of contact with the Lycanthropes who made their home there.

You still see him on occasion, mostly when it is time to discuss relations or policy, and he acts the same as he ever did, approaching his duty with a hard-swallowed stoicism.

Hayill eventually becomes an important source of manpower, as the indefatigable people there spread out across the island, and werewolves become a common sight in the fledgling communities.
column2:
当你征服全岛已成定局时，Grant 回到了海伊尔，最终成了你与定居在那里的狼人族之间的联络人。

你偶尔还会见到他，大多是在需要商讨两族关系或政策的时候。他还是老样子，以一种强咽苦水般的坚忍对待自己的职责。

海伊尔最终成了重要的人力来源，那里不知疲倦的人们散布到岛上各处，狼人在新生的聚落里也成了常见的景象。

column1:
With the blessing of his father, Grant remained with you, to serve as a symbol of the Lycanthropes dedication to the new nation.

He has remained close, helpful, and eager to pitch in, whether you need an extra pair of hands with rebuilding or an extra pair of folded arms at a negotiation table.

Owing to his high visibility, Hayill soon sees a fair amount of immigration from the mainland and becomes a secondary hub for your government, overseeing the entirety of the Knightwood region.

Werewolf guardsmen in uniform are a common sight in western towns, and common folk, once wary, have come to rely upon them.

Grant is very proud of this, and remains your confidant and friend.
column2:
在父亲的祝福下，Grant 留在了你身边，作为狼人族效忠这个新国家的象征。

他一直与你亲近，乐于助人，总是积极搭把手——不管你需要的是重建时多一双干活的手，还是谈判桌旁多一双抱在胸前的胳膊。

由于他声名在外，海伊尔很快迎来了相当数量的大陆移民，并成为你政府的第二中心，统辖整个骑士林地区。

身穿制服的狼人卫兵在西部城镇随处可见，曾经心存戒备的平民百姓也渐渐开始依赖他们。

Grant 对此十分自豪，他始终是你的知己和朋友。

column1:
Greave took the reformation of the island very seriously, and ended up making it his personal mission to dismantle the stocks and other facilities like it.

He met surprisingly little opposition, and eventually gathered what few good guardsmen he could find and returned to the Crest mainland to make sure that the general populace heard all about what Lukatt really was.

His news enraged the people, most of whom had a friend of a friend who had been shipped out, and now, at the risk of making enemies of a lot of powerful men, he is trying to start an inquest to uncover corruption within Crest's judiciary system.
column2:
Greave 对岛上的改革极为认真，最终把拆除枷场及类似设施当成了自己的个人使命。

他遇到的阻力出奇地小。最终，他召集了自己能找到的为数不多的正派卫兵，回到克雷斯特大陆，确保普通民众都听清楚卢卡特的真面目。

他带回的消息激起了民愤——大多数人都有某个朋友的朋友被发配到了岛上。如今，他冒着与许多权贵结仇的风险，正试图发起一场调查，揭露克雷斯特司法体系内部的腐败。

column1:
Greave swore that he wouldn't let another travesty like the stocks occur again, so when the island was taken, he asked you to put him in charge of dismantling the remaining facilities.

When he and his team marched on the stocks, they found them severely undermanned, and quickly rounded up what soldiers and prisoners remained.

With a little work, he was able to convert the stocks into a coastal stronghold, and he remains there, helping to coordinate rebuilding efforts on the west coast of the island.

Mainly, he focuses on preventing Crest infiltrators from interfering with the development of the young nation, and he remains dedicated and driven.
column2:
Greave 发誓绝不让枷场这样的丑恶之事再次发生，所以在全岛被攻下后，他请求你让他负责拆除剩余的设施。

当他和他的队伍向枷场进军时，发现那里人手严重不足，很快就把剩下的士兵和囚犯一网打尽。

稍加改造后，他把枷场变成了一座海岸据点，并一直驻守在那里，协调岛屿西海岸的重建工作。

他的主要精力放在防止克雷斯特的渗透者干扰这个年轻国家的发展上，始终尽忠职守、干劲十足。

column1:
Once a permanent stronghold was established, Greening appointed himself "dinnermaster" and set up a community eatery.

He relies on some good old-fashioned cooking for the most part, only very occasionally (he promises) testing out his magicks on unsuspecting diners.

For the most part, he remains well-liked among the people, and is glad to be using his talents for roasting entrees instead of enemies.
column2:
永久据点建立起来后，Greening 自封为“膳食大师”，开了一家公共食堂。

他大多数时候靠的是老派的传统厨艺，只是非常偶尔地（他保证）拿毫无防备的食客试验他的魔法。

总的来说，他在民众中依然很受欢迎，也很高兴能把自己的天赋用来烤主菜，而不是烤敌人。

column1:
Greening seemed a bit lost once rebuilding efforts began, and was not particularly well-suited to the requisite labour.

He made an effort to help out with provisioning whenever he could, and seemed to really enjoy it, so once you had enough hands to keep things running without him, you suggested that he open his own cafe, and he took to the notion with enthusiastic delight.

He fussed over the precise design and layout of the place for far longer than was necessary, but eventually, he opened shop, and now he and a few carefully-trained assistants run a tight business.

His cafe is particularly popular with visiting dignitaries who appreciate his eccentric taste and attention to detail, and he seems happy to be there.
column2:
重建工作开始后，Greening 显得有些无所适从，他也不太适合干那些必需的体力活。

他一有机会就努力帮忙筹备伙食，而且看起来真的乐在其中。所以等你手下的人手足够、没有他也能维持运转时，你建议他开一家自己的咖啡馆，他兴高采烈地接受了这个主意。

他在店面的精确设计和布局上折腾了远远超出必要的时间，但最终还是开张了。如今，他和几个精心培训过的助手把店经营得井井有条。

他的咖啡馆尤其受到来访显贵的青睐，他们欣赏他古怪的品味和对细节的讲究，而他在那里似乎过得很开心。

column1: Kirilo took almost immediately to watching out for newly-arriving immigrants, accompanying convoys along the roads and making sure that everybody was safely settled in.\n\nYou hear mixed reports regarding him, some appreciative and others less so, but he is trying his best to stay involved and to give honest people a chance to dig in to their new lives.
column2: Kirilo 几乎立刻就开始照看新到岛上的移民，沿路护送车队，确保每个人都安全落脚。\n\n你听到的关于他的评价褒贬不一，有人感激，也有人不那么领情，但他一直在尽力参与其中，给老实人一个扎根新生活的机会。

column1:
Kirilo seemed like he was going to involve himself regardless, so when smaller communities of immigrants began to form on the island, you appointed Kirilo the head of security for a group of them and gave him the authority and funds to hire his own people.

He makes regular reports to you as to the status of his districts, and all reports suggest that under his guidance, those communities have remained very safe. 

He remains well-regarded by the downtrodden (and formerly downtrodden), and would have it no other way.
column2:
Kirilo 看样子无论如何都要插手，所以当岛上开始形成小型移民聚落时，你任命 Kirilo 为其中几个聚落的治安总管，并授予他自行招募人手的权力和资金。

他定期向你汇报辖区的状况，所有报告都表明，在他的看管下，那些聚落一直非常安全。 

他始终受到受压迫者（以及曾经的受压迫者）的敬重，而他也正希望如此。

column1:
Leftie's mood turned foul as more people arrived on the island, and after the first few loads of immigrants arrived, he withdrew.

You heard rumors that a man matching his description was spotted with a ragtag mercenary crew.

Though you can't be certain if those rumors are true or not, one thing you can be sure of is that Leftie wants no part of civilized life.
column2:
随着越来越多的人来到岛上，Leftie 的心情变得越来越糟。头几批移民抵达后，他就离开了。

你听到传言说，有人看见一个长相与他相符的男人混在一支乌合之众的雇佣兵队伍里。

虽然你无法确定这些传言是真是假，但有一点你可以肯定：Leftie 对文明生活毫无兴趣。

column1:
When you chose to keep Leftie close instead of cutting him free, something moved within the giant man, and he devoted himself to you and to your campaigns wholeheartedly.

His breadth of experience working odd jobs and his unsinkable constitution have made him an invaluable asset to the rebuilding efforts, and he is high in demand when labour teams are being chosen.

Being away from the mainland long-term seems to have given him some sense of closure, and he works hard to ensure that his second chance at life is not wasted.

He makes his home near your capital stronghold, and still makes efforts to see you as often as he can. He often tells you to call upon him at the slightest need, and regards you highly as both a leader and as a friend.
column2:
当你选择把 Leftie 留在身边，而不是放他自由时，这个巨人内心深处有什么东西被触动了。他从此全心全意地投身于你和你的事业。

他干过各种零活，经验丰富，体格又坚不可摧，这让他成为重建工作中不可或缺的宝贵人才，每次挑选劳作队时他都是抢手货。

长期远离大陆似乎让他放下了某种心结，他努力工作，决心不浪费这第二次生命的机会。

他在你的首都据点附近安了家，至今仍尽可能常来看你。他常说只要你有一点点需要就尽管找他，并且无论作为首领还是作为朋友，他都对你推崇备至。

column1:
Although Moria participated eagerly in the conquest of the island, once all of the major battles had been won, she had little interest in participating further.

She left to live on her own, away from the conveniences and confines of civilization, and you have heard no reports of her at all.

Presumably she is happier to be left alone.
column2:
尽管 Moria 曾积极参与征服全岛的战斗，但所有大战都打完之后，她就对继续参与没什么兴趣了。

她离开了，远离文明的便利与束缚独自生活，你再也没有听到过任何关于她的消息。

想必她更乐意一个人清静。

column1:
Moria, having been disillusioned on the trappings of modern civilization already, seemed uneasy when your campaigns shifted from battle to rebuilding. She clearly didn't want to be part of the bustle of new and growing communities.

Knowing that she preferred her life to be hard-fought, you asked her if she would consider helping on the frontiers as a ranger, hunting and scouting, and this idea seemed to appeal to her.

You hardly ever hear from her anymore, but she is spotted from time to time in town, selling pelts or meat at the marketplaces, and sometimes guiding lost travelers to safe communities.

She clearly prefers to be left alone, but her continued participation tells you that she is content.
column2:
Moria 早已对现代文明的种种浮华感到幻灭，当你的事业从战斗转向重建时，她显得很不自在。她显然不想卷入新兴聚落的喧嚣之中。

你知道她更喜欢靠拼搏过活，便问她是否愿意去边疆当一名游侠，帮忙狩猎和侦察，这个主意似乎正合她意。

如今你几乎再也听不到她的消息，但偶尔会有人看到她出现在镇上，在集市里卖毛皮或肉，有时还会为迷路的旅人引路，把他们带到安全的聚落。

她显然更喜欢独来独往，但她一直还在出力，这让你知道她过得很满足。

column1:
Nazar made good on his promise to keep your shoulders warm, and he has cheerfully made a space for himself in your bed every night since that night in the old church.

Once events with Crest began to settle down, and it became clear that life on the island would be more relaxed, the two of you were married formally, in a grand ceremony in the capital, before a crowd of hundreds of cheering Lukattites.

Supporting both your efforts to help reconstruct life on the island and you personally, people began to quietly compare him to the memory of Maxim Spartill, lord consort of the island's last queen.

As the closest and dearest admirer of his heroic form and demeanor, you find that comparison difficult to argue.
column2:
Nazar 兑现了替你暖肩膀的承诺，自从那天晚上在旧教堂里之后，他每晚都兴高采烈地在你床上给自己占一块地方。

等到与克雷斯特之间的事态逐渐平息、岛上的生活显然会变得更加安逸之后，你们俩在首都举行了一场盛大的婚礼，在数百名欢呼的卢卡特人面前正式结为夫妻。

他既支持你重建岛上生活的事业，也支持你本人，人们开始悄悄地把他与 Maxim Spartill——岛上最后一位女王的王夫——相提并论。

作为他英武身姿与气度最亲密、最痴迷的仰慕者，你发现这个比较实在很难反驳。

column1:
Nazar was seemingly involved in everything once events on the island began to pick up. 

He participated eagerly in both the conquest and the rebuilding effort, lending a cheerful hand to anyone who asked.

He still comes by your stronghold to see you from time to time, and last you heard from him, he was working with a shipbiulding crew in Greenback Bay.
column2:
岛上的局势一热闹起来，Nazar 就好像什么事都要掺和一脚。 

无论是征服还是重建，他都热情参与，谁开口他都乐呵呵地帮忙。

他至今仍不时到你的据点来看你。你最后一次听到他的消息时，他正在绿背湾的一支造船队里干活。

column1:
Nazar was eager to involve himself with the labour crews once rebuilding began, and quickly established himself as "foreman" once again.

He remained close to you, even as rebuilding efforts spread across the island, and you began to hear rumors that he was gaining something of a reputation as a heartbreaker. Apparently he attracted a great number of interested suitors, yet rebuffed them all.

When you asked him about it in friendly conversation, he seemed rather embarassed, telling you that there was in fact someone whose eye he was hoping to catch.

Nazar remains close by, making himself available for whatever you need, and continuing to turn away suitors while waiting patiently for the one he really wants to notice him.
column2:
重建开始后，Nazar 迫不及待地加入了劳作队，很快又一次当上了“工头”。

即使重建工作扩展到全岛各地，他也一直留在你身边。你开始听到传言，说他渐渐有了“万人迷”的名声。据说有一大群追求者对他有意，却都被他一一回绝了。

当你在闲聊中友好地问起这件事时，他显得相当难为情，告诉你其实他一直希望能引起某个人的注意。

Nazar 始终守在你身边，随时听候你的差遣，一边继续拒绝追求者，一边耐心地等待他真正心仪的那个人注意到他。

column1:
Paul seemed a bit lost after the island was conquered, unsure whether to celebrate with everyone else or not.

Though most people seemed to have no problem with him or with giants in general, he seemed self-conscious. He went back to being a labourer for hire, ensuring that only those who truly wanted his services would have them.

Most recent reports say that he is employed with a logging crew in the Knightwood region, where his knowledge of the terrain and great strength are high in demand.
column2:
全岛被征服后，Paul 显得有些茫然，不确定自己该不该和大家一起庆祝。

虽然大多数人似乎对他、对巨人整体都没什么意见，他却显得很不自在。他重操旧业，当起了雇工，确保只有真心需要他的人才会雇他。

最近的消息说，他受雇于骑士林地区的一支伐木队，在那里，他对地形的了解和过人的力气都十分抢手。

column1:
Once the conquest of the island was complete, Paul quickly became instrumental in the rebuilding efforts.

He and some of the others came together and formed their own organization to coordinate divisions of labour and supplies, and Paul was there in the thick of it. He was frequently seen inspecting shipments in port and reviewing building sites to ensure that the work was solid.

He has since established a headquarters for his guild in Greenback Bay, where he hosts visiting experts and workers as needed.

Although you did not personally oversee its formation, Paul makes a point of reporting the labour guild's progress to you, perhaps more as an excuse to see you face-to-face than out of necessity, and he remains very loudly fond of you.
column2:
全岛征服完成后，Paul 很快就成了重建工作中的关键人物。

他和其他一些人联合起来，成立了自己的组织，协调劳力和物资的分配，而 Paul 始终冲在最前线。人们常常看到他在港口检查货物，或者巡视工地，确保工程扎实可靠。

后来，他在绿背湾为他的行会建立了总部，按需接待来访的专家和工人。

虽然你并没有亲自督导这个劳工行会的成立，但 Paul 坚持向你汇报行会的进展——与其说是出于必要，倒不如说是找个借口和你见面——而他对你的喜爱依然表现得十分大声。

column1:
Peregrine particularly delighted in the conquest of the island and the struggle with Crest that followed immediately thereafter.

He traveled back and forth between Lukatt and the mainland regularly, being something of a deliberate thorn in the side of haughty politicians, and using the island as a sort of safe home base.

You have, of course, heard rumors of this, but no official complaints or reports have come to you, so for the time being, it seems unnecessary to interfere.
column2:
Peregrine 对征服全岛以及紧随其后与克雷斯特的斗争格外兴致勃勃。

他经常往返于卢卡特和大陆之间，故意给那些傲慢的政客添堵，并把这座岛当作某种安全的大本营。

你当然也听到了这方面的传言，但从没有正式的投诉或报告送到你这里，所以眼下似乎没有必要插手。

column1:
With a lack of anyone wealthy to plunder, or indeed, a lack of much use for wealth on the island at all, Peregrine found himself living his cover story full time once the island's conquest was secured.

He moved to Greenback Bay and helped out at first with the crews building Lukatt's new navy, and then later hiring on to shipping voyages.

He clearly prefers life on the move, and is so hard to track that you rarely see him, but every once in a great while, he'll stop in and force you to make time to share a drink or a dirty story.
column2:
岛上没有什么有钱人可以打劫，或者说，岛上根本就没什么用得着财富的地方，所以全岛的征服大局一定，Peregrine 就发现自己只能全天候地过着他那套掩护身份的生活了。

他搬到了绿背湾，一开始帮忙建造卢卡特的新海军，后来又受雇参加航运远航。

他显然更喜欢漂泊不定的生活，行踪难觅，你很少见到他。但隔上很久很久，他会突然登门，逼着你抽出时间陪他喝一杯，或者听他讲个下流故事。

column1:
Rangda eagerly lent her sword to the conquest of the island, and was one of the first to pledge herself as a permanent citizen of Lukatt.

She was instrumental in the formation of Lukatt's military, eager to work with veterans and soldiers outside of the context of Tsarath's laws, and she even spearheaded a training program specifically for women and girls.

Reports on her progress suggest that she is not particularly popular with her recruits, however, as she tends to be harder on them than even the standard military training programs.

Attendance in her program is low, and the dropout rate is high.
column2:
Rangda 积极地为征服全岛贡献了她的剑，也是第一批宣誓成为卢卡特永久公民的人之一。

她在组建卢卡特军队的过程中发挥了关键作用，热衷于在察拉思法律的框架之外与老兵和士兵合作，甚至还牵头开办了一个专门面向妇女和女孩的训练项目。

不过，关于她进展的报告显示，她在新兵中并不怎么受欢迎，因为她对他们往往比常规军事训练项目还要严苛。

她的项目参加的人少，退出的人多。

column1:
Rangda was adamant that she be involved with the reformation of Lukatt's military forces, and so once the conquest was complete, she set up a training camp for willing recruits.

Though her teaching style was at first harsh and unpopular, she regularly came to you for advice, and eventually, she relaxed a little and learned to meet the students halfway. Attendance in her program is soaring, with a steady stream of fresh-faced men and women willing and ready to pitch in and defend their new homeland.

She is now an officer in the growing ranks of Lukatt's military, and she seems pleased to have found a place where she can live the life she chooses.
column2:
Rangda 坚决要求参与卢卡特军队的改组，所以征服一结束，她就为自愿入伍的新兵建立了一座训练营。

虽然她的教学风格起初严厉又不受欢迎，但她经常来向你请教。最终，她放松了一些，学会了与学员们各让一步。如今她的项目报名人数猛增，一批又一批朝气蓬勃的男男女女源源不断地前来，随时准备出一份力，保卫他们的新家园。

她现在是卢卡特日益壮大的军队中的一名军官，似乎很高兴找到了一个可以按自己选择的方式生活的地方。

column1:
Rosaline was happy to be a part of the young nation rising on Lukatt, and offered her services to you as an informant and a spy.

Though you had some doubts initially, a few test cases have proven her extraordinarily competent in this regard, and she was able to give you ample warning in a few situations when agitators from Crest planned to undermine your new nation.

She is a constant fixture in your stronghold and at any political arrangements that arise, and she seems pleased to be involved.
column2:
Rosaline 很高兴能成为在卢卡特崛起的这个年轻国家的一分子，并主动提出为你担任线人和间谍。

虽然你起初有些怀疑，但几次试探证明她在这方面能力非凡。有几次克雷斯特的煽动者图谋破坏你的新国家，她都及早向你发出了警告。

她是你据点里的常驻人物，任何政治场合都少不了她，而她似乎也很乐意参与其中。

column1:
When politics began creeping in to the island, Rosaline insisted on offering her services to you as an informant and spy. Seeing that she would not be dissuaded, you accepted her offer.

Ostensibly, she haunts your events as a courtesan, sometimes as a Lukattite and other times masquerading as a foreign dignitary. Her extensive training in subterfuge serve her well in this, often providing interesting insight, and she soon becomes indispensable at the negotiating table.

She insists that she finds the intrigue of court both more palatable than assassinations and more fun than she had expected, so she remains on hand, eager to attend any event you need her for.
column2:
当政治开始渗入岛上时，Rosaline 坚持要为你担任线人和间谍。眼看劝不动她，你便接受了她的提议。

表面上，她以交际花的身份出没于你的各种场合，有时扮作卢卡特人，有时则伪装成外国显贵。她在诡计方面受过的大量训练让她在这方面如鱼得水，常常能带来有趣的见解，她很快就成了谈判桌上不可或缺的人物。

她坚称，她觉得宫廷里的勾心斗角既比暗杀更合胃口，也比她预想的有趣得多，所以她一直随时待命，只要你需要她出席，她都乐意前往。

column1: When the conquest was complete, Shapiro did what any self-respecting sorcerer would do; he hired a crew to build an ominous tower a short distance from your stronghold and moved in.\n\nHe spends his days in isolation, researching and experimenting, venturing out only once in a while to browse the markets for supplies or to replace a singed coat, and he seems quite content to play the role of the hermit wizard.
column2: 征服完成后，Shapiro 做了任何一个有自尊的巫师都会做的事：他雇了一队人，在离你据点不远的地方建起一座阴森的高塔，然后搬了进去。\n\n他每天与世隔绝，埋头研究和实验，只是偶尔出门逛逛集市采购材料，或者换一件烧焦的外套。他似乎很满足于扮演隐居巫师的角色。

column1:
Once your permanent stronghold was secured, Shapiro set out to establish a formal guild of magic on the island, a task he claimed was more borne of necessity than of desire. With a little time and effort, he was eventually able to arrange an appropriate facility a short distance away from your capital.

Though his demeanor is at a times cold and unsettling, his knowledge regarding magic is undeniably broad, and his experience in guild practice and politics has been especially valuable as your people continue to uncover strange arcana all over the island.

He makes himself available for consultation whenever any relevant situations arise, but mostly he happily keeps to himself in the new guild, taking apprentices, conducting his (assuredly safe) experiments, and giving the arcane arts a solid foothold in your new home.
column2:
你的永久据点稳固之后，Shapiro 便着手在岛上建立一个正式的魔法行会——他声称这项任务与其说是出于意愿，不如说是出于必要。花了些时间和功夫后，他终于在离你首都不远的地方安排好了一处合适的场所。

虽然他的举止有时冷漠得令人不安，但他在魔法方面的学识无可否认地广博，而随着你的人民不断在岛上各处发掘出奇异的秘术，他在行会事务和政治方面的经验显得尤为宝贵。

每当出现相关情况时，他都随时可供咨询，但大多数时候，他都乐得在新行会里独处，收徒授业，进行他那些（保证安全的）实验，让奥术在你的新家园站稳脚跟。

column1:
Vankan stayed with you during and after the conquest of the island, seemingly reluctant to let you out of his sight.

Though he said nothing and put on a cheerful face, something was clearly bothering him.

One day, as negotiations with Crest dignitaries were about to commence, one of the man's aides pulled a blow gun and launched a dart at you. As if he knew it was coming, Vankan threw himself in front of you, and the dart struck him instead.

He died in your arms a moment later, ravaged by poison as your guards put your would-be assassin to the sword, but when he went, his face seemed peaceful.
column2:
在征服全岛期间及之后，Vankan 一直留在你身边，似乎不愿让你离开他的视线。

虽然他什么也没说，脸上也总是挂着笑容，但显然有什么事在困扰着他。

有一天，就在与克雷斯特显贵的谈判即将开始时，对方的一名随从掏出一根吹箭筒，朝你射出一支飞镖。Vankan 仿佛早就料到会发生这一幕，飞身挡在你面前，飞镖射中了他。

片刻之后，他被毒药摧残着死在了你怀里，与此同时，你的卫兵将那个刺客斩于剑下。但他离去时，脸上似乎很安详。

column1:
Relieved beyond measure that you had not been forced to slay Leviathan, Vankan devoted himself to the divine beast's worship. His unique gift apparently made it easier for him to commune, and so Vankan alternately serves you as an advisor and, when it is needed, as a mouthpiece for Leviathan.

Despite his protests, a small cult has risen up around him, and you have encouraged him to accept the role and to guide them with compassion and humility.

His newfound "Sunken Order" works tirelessly to help new settlers however they can, and to remind people to thank Leviathan for their small fortunes, and Leviathan tells you, both through Vankan's voice and through his brief communions with you, that he is pleased at their efforts.

As for Vankan himself, he is busier than ever before, but also seems at peace, and still regards you most warmly.
column2:
得知你不必被迫杀死 Leviathan，Vankan 如释重负，从此全心侍奉这头神兽。他独特的天赋显然让他更容易与之沟通，于是 Vankan 一边担任你的顾问，一边在需要时充当 Leviathan 的代言人。

尽管他一再推辞，他身边还是兴起了一个小小的教派。你鼓励他接受这个角色，以慈悲和谦卑引导信众。

他新成立的“沉没教团”不知疲倦地尽其所能帮助新来的移民，并提醒人们为自己的小小福分感谢 Leviathan。而 Leviathan 也通过 Vankan 之口以及与你短暂的直接交流告诉你，他对他们的努力很满意。

至于 Vankan 本人，他比以往任何时候都要忙碌，却也显得内心平和，而且依然待你极为亲切。

column1:
Wisaka stayed with you during the conquest of the island, but afterward, when the adventuring gave way to rebuilding and politics, he lost interest.

He left your company and made way for Hayill in order to be with other lycanthropes, but even that place failed to hold his interest for long.

Now, you hear people talk from time to time of "The Howling Bard" who wanders from place to place, meeting new people every day but never content to stay around for long.
column2:
Wisaka 在征服全岛期间一直留在你身边，但之后冒险让位于重建和政治，他便失去了兴趣。

他离开了你的队伍，动身前往海伊尔，想和其他狼人族待在一起，但就连那里也没能留住他多久。

如今，你不时听到人们谈起一位“嚎月诗人”，他四处漂泊，每天结识新的人，却从不肯在一个地方久留。

column1:
Wisaka seemed to have no place to fit in once the rebuilding started, but for his fondness of you personally, he stuck around anyway. He talked about going to Hayill from time to time, but never actually packed up and left.

Once you began receiving foreign dignitaries in your stronghold, however, things began to change. Idly plucking away at his lute one day in court, a visiting noblewoman became absolutely enraptured with him. She immediately contracted the construction of a summer home on the island, and she positively insists on organizing eccentric annual festivals that showcase the varied talents of native Lukattites.

Opinions of these festivals range from inspired to tasteless, but Wisaka features prominently, and he seems thrilled to be widely known and well-regarded.
column2:
重建开始后，Wisaka 似乎找不到自己的位置，但出于对你个人的喜爱，他还是留了下来。他时不时说起要去海伊尔，却从没真正收拾行装离开过。

然而，当你开始在据点里接待外国显贵后，事情有了变化。有一天，他在宫廷里随手拨弄着鲁特琴，一位来访的贵妇人竟被他迷得神魂颠倒。她立刻签约在岛上修建了一座避暑别墅，还非要每年举办古怪的节庆活动，展示卢卡特本地人的各种才艺不可。

人们对这些节庆的评价从“灵感迸发”到“低俗无味”不等，但 Wisaka 总是其中的主角，而他似乎为自己声名远扬、广受好评而激动不已。

column1: Zantanak remained by your side faithfully and obediently, serving as your bodyguard and advisor continually, as your pact with him demanded.\n\nLoathe to wear a disguise, he has taken to dressing in regal fineries and making a show of his advisory role, and he seems to take great pleasure in the startled expressions of visiting politicians.
column2: Zantanak 忠实而顺从地留在你身边，一直担任你的保镖和顾问，正如你与他订立的契约所要求的那样。\n\n他不屑于伪装，干脆穿上华贵的盛装，大张旗鼓地扮演他的顾问角色，而且似乎非常享受来访政客们那副大惊失色的表情。

column1:
As communities grew and your influence continued to expand, Zantanak seemed to have trouble adapting, and one day asked you where he fit into your plans.

Since his only obligation to you was to serve as your bodyguard and advisor, during your discussion with him, you determined that he would in fact have time to pursue other interests, and almost immediately, he asked you if he would be allowed to take a wife.

You granted him permission to wed any woman who would have him, and he seemed satisfied.

Zantanak has not yet chosen a wife, but seems to appreciate the consideration, and as time passes, he seems to settle more and more. He makes friends, saying he is "establishing contacts" and tours the stronghold to "maintain visibility" but it is clear that he is beginning to enjoy his time spent amid mortals.
column2:
随着聚落不断发展、你的影响力持续扩大，Zantanak 似乎难以适应。有一天，他问你，他在你的计划里处于什么位置。

既然他对你唯一的义务就是担任你的保镖和顾问，你在与他讨论时便认定他其实有时间去追求别的兴趣。他几乎立刻就问你，能不能允许他娶个妻子。

你准许他迎娶任何愿意嫁给他的女人，他似乎很满意。

Zantanak 至今还没选好妻子，但似乎很感激你的体谅。随着时间的推移，他似乎越来越安定下来。他结交朋友，说自己是在“建立人脉”；他巡视据点，说是为了“保持存在感”。但很明显，他开始享受在凡人之间度过的时光了。

column1:
With the death of the Leviathan, the seas and skies surrounding the island went eerily calm, as though mourning the loss of their master.

A few weeks of searching eventually turned up a ship in the Miser's Purse that could be made seaworthy with a little work, so you relocated your stronghold one last time and made it your project.

When the work was complete, your band piled on and nervously set out into the calm sea, and before long, the island of Lukatt was a distant speck on the horizon as you sailed for the Orc Nation of Tsarath.
column2:
随着 Leviathan 的死去，岛屿周围的海洋与天空变得出奇地平静，仿佛在哀悼它们主人的逝去。

经过几周的搜寻，你们终于在守财奴钱袋找到了一艘稍加修理就能出海的船。于是你最后一次迁移了据点，把修船当成了自己的工程。

工程完成后，你的团伙纷纷登船，忐忑不安地驶入平静的大海。没过多久，卢卡特岛就成了地平线上一个遥远的小点，而你们正扬帆驶向兽人国度察拉思。

column1: After leading such a large band of people, returning to a regular civilian life seemed dull, so instead you traveled to a small community on the frontiers of Tsarath, where bands of nomads roamed and survival was hard-fought.\n\nThere, you built a modest homestead for yourself, and you lived out your days working for a satisfying life that felt well-earned.
column2: 领导过这么一大帮人之后，回归普通平民生活显得太过乏味，于是你去了察拉思边疆的一个小聚落。那里有游牧部落四处游荡，生存全靠拼搏。\n\n你在那里为自己建了一座简朴的家园，余生都在为一种踏实、来之不易的满足生活而劳作。

column1: Your experiences on Lukatt made a return to normal civilian life all but impossible, so you ended up joining a mercenary band in order to prevent yourself from becoming too comfortable.\n\nThough you still managed to keep a small home near a frontier town, you traveled often, and that life suited you better than putting down roots ever had. Your work afforded you an endless variety of interesting new experiences, and life was never boring.
column2: 在卢卡特的经历让你几乎不可能再回归正常的平民生活，所以你最终加入了一支雇佣兵团，免得自己过得太安逸。\n\n虽然你仍设法在一座边疆小镇附近保留了一处小小的住所，但你经常四处奔波，这种生活比安家落户更适合你。你的工作为你带来了无穷无尽的有趣新经历，生活从不乏味。

column1: You settled in Tsarath quickly, managing to find a quiet place to live somewhere people wouldn't ask a lot of questions.\n\nYour time spent struggling for survival on the island seemed like a distant nightmare, and the familiar rhythm of calm daily life welcomed you once again.
column2: 你很快就在察拉思安顿下来，设法找了一处清静的地方住下，那里的人不会追问太多。\n\n你在岛上挣扎求生的日子仿佛成了一场遥远的噩梦，平静生活那熟悉的节奏再次迎接了你。

column1:
Bato, a small man even by human standards, had difficulty finding work in a nation already oversaturated with strong orcish labourers.

He eventually found a labour commune that was willing to take him in, and he worked hard to earn his keep, but found it more difficult to earn the respect of his peers.

He frequently suffered abuse of all sorts at their hands, and eventually, he left, choosing a solitary life over the constant ridicule.

You have not heard from him since.
column2:
即便以人类的标准来看，Bato 也身材矮小。在一个强壮的兽人劳工已经多到过剩的国家里，他很难找到工作。

他最终找到一个愿意收留他的劳作公社。他埋头苦干，总算养活了自己，可同伴的尊重却难赢得多。

他经常在他们手里遭受各种各样的虐待，最终离开了。他宁可一个人过，也不愿再忍受没完没了的嘲笑。

自那以后，你再没听到过他的消息。

column1:
Bato, a devoted friend to the very core, was always close at hand once you arrived in Tsarath.

Though he sometimes bordered on overbearing, he always put on a bright face and kept after you to take care of yourself, and having him nearby made the transition into your new life easier.

He made a point of helping out with repairs, construction, and hunting in your new home whenever an opportunity arose, and eventually attracted the attention of a few bright-eyed young orcs who follow him around like lost pups.

He managed to shape them up into a freelance labour crew, and seems happy to be at the center of their attention.
column2:
Bato 是个忠到骨子里的朋友。你们一到察拉思，他就始终守在近旁。

他有时几乎强势得让人吃不消，但总是一脸开朗，不停催你照顾好自己。有他在身边，转入新生活容易了许多。

只要有机会，他就一定要在你的新家帮忙修缮、盖房子、打猎，最终引来几个眼睛亮晶晶的年轻兽人，像走丢的小狗似的跟着他转。

他总算把他们收拾成一支接散活的劳作队，似乎很高兴自己成了他们关注的中心。

column1: Though he helped with building the boat, Beauregard was unwilling to leave behind the only home he had ever known, and he did not make the journey to Tsarath with you.\n\nHe remained on Lukatt and moved into Spartill Lodge, one of the few remaining familiar places to him, and is presumably still there, making a place for himself among the people who still dwell on the island.
column2: 虽然他帮着造了船，Beauregard 却不愿抛下自己唯一熟悉的家，没有和你一起前往察拉思。\n\n他留在卢卡特，搬进了斯帕蒂尔旅舍，那是他剩下的少数还熟悉的地方之一。想必他至今还在那里，在仍然住在岛上的人中间给自己谋一个位置。

column1:
Seeing his whole world in shambles was painful for him, so convincing Beauregard to come to Tsarath with you was not difficult. He had even been there once before, hundreds of years past, and seemed eager to see their progress.

He eventually found himself a place in one of the many Tsarathi military schools, where spending his time training and parenting the young orc boys seemed to soothe his confusion, and his mood lightened considerably in the years that followed.

He never had a chance at marrying, but surrounded as he is by his adopted nephews, his life is a happy one.
column2:
眼看自己的整个世界支离破碎，他痛苦不堪，所以劝 Beauregard 跟你去察拉思并不难。几百年前他甚至去过那里一次，似乎急于看看他们现在走到了哪一步。

他最终在众多察拉思军校中的一所找到了自己的位置。把时间用来训练那些年轻的兽人男孩，并像父亲一样照看他们，似乎抚平了他的茫然。其后的年月里，他的心情也轻快了不少。

他始终没有机会结婚，但身边围着他认下的侄儿们，生活是幸福的。

column1: When your band began work on the boat, Borfalgor, unsure of your destination or your motivations, disappeared one night and did not return.\n\nPresumably, he has returned to whatever it was he was doing before you found him, living his life on the island where he was born.
column2: 当你的团伙开始造船时，Borfalgor 摸不清你要去哪里，也不清楚你的动机，一天夜里消失了，再也没有回来。\n\n想必他回到了你找到他之前在做的事上，在自己出生的那座岛上过他的日子。

column1:
Borfalgor was eager to see the world outside of Lukatt, and made the journey to Tsarath with you, unafraid of the consequences.

Though his reception in Tsarath was not exactly warm, he was for the most part tolerated.

One day in the marketplace, thanks to his keen eye for jewelry, he spotted a trader selling fake stones and managed to very publicly prove the man's fraud. He was approached by a merchant and offered an ongoing job overseeing and appraising valuables.

He draws a lot of business to the shop on his novelty alone, and he gets to see an endless parade of priceless treasures brought before him, all without having to leave his lavish accomodations, and he seems happy with the place he has found himself.
column2:
Borfalgor 渴望看看卢卡特以外的世界，不怕会有什么后果，和你一起去了察拉思。

察拉思对他的接待谈不上热络，但大体上人们还容忍着他。

一天在集市上，凭着对珠宝极准的眼力，他发现一个商贩在卖假宝石，并当众把那人的欺诈揭了个明白。一位商人随即找上门，给了他一份长期差事，负责监看并估价贵重物品。

单凭他这副稀罕样子，他就给铺子招来了大量生意。他不必离开自己奢华的住所，就能看见数不尽的无价之宝被送到面前，而他对自己如今的处境似乎很满意。

column1: Since she had come to Lukatt voluntarily, when you arrived in Tsarath, Borgnina immediately began to make arrangements for transport on another ship bound for Crest.\n\nShe returned to her previous community in order to announce the success of her pilgrimage, but then quickly requested transfer to another hamlet, where she has settled back into old patterns, serving as an agent of law and faith.
column2: 她当初是自愿来到卢卡特的，所以你们一到察拉思，Borgnina 立刻就开始安排搭乘另一艘驶往克雷斯特的船。\n\n她回到原先的社群，宣布自己的朝圣已经成功，随即却很快请求调往另一座小村。她在那里重新过回从前那一套，担任律法与信仰的代理人。

column1:
Borgnina threw away her raiments before the boat landed in Tsarath. Though her faith in her God was shaken, her faith in her order had been long since exhausted, and she no longer wished to identify with them.

Instead, she took it upon herself to exemplify her faith personally, and live her life more freely than she had before.

She took a home in a slum by choice, and tried her best to be an uplifting influence to the downtrodden people who surround her, and after a few years, she even married a strong orc who adored her adamant spirit.

Life for Borgnina is not how she imagined it, but she claims she has no regrets.
column2:
船还没在察拉思靠岸，Borgnina 就把法衣扔了。她对神的信仰虽然动摇了，对教团的信仰却早已耗尽，再也不愿与他们算作一路。

于是她决意亲自活出自己的信仰，过得比从前更自由。

她自己选择住进贫民窟，尽力鼓舞身边那些受压迫的人。几年后，她甚至嫁给了一个强壮的兽人，对方爱慕她那股怎么也不肯弯的性子。

Borgnina 的日子并不像她想象的那样，但她声称自己并不后悔。

column1:
Despite the danger, Byrne came with you on the boat to Tsarath, eager to leave the memory of his time with Frico behind him.

Wrapped in white robes, he hid in a leper colony where he thought nobody would look for a vampire, and he was so shocked by the understanding welcome he was given, he decided to make his permanent home there.

He subsists on the blood of wildlife and of grateful volunteers, and he serves quietly as the colony's protector and their connection to the outside world.
column2:
尽管有危险，Byrne 还是跟你坐船去了察拉思，急着把和 Frico 在一起的记忆抛在身后。

他裹上白袍，躲进一处麻风病人聚居地，心想没人会到那种地方找一个吸血鬼。人们带着理解迎接他，这让他震惊，于是他决定在那里长久住下去。

他以野兽的血和心怀感激的自愿者的血为食，并默默地充当聚居地的保护者，以及他们与外界的联络人。

column1: Byrne returned to Frico's service when you left the island.\n\nHe quietly did as he was told for many years thereafter, bringing Frico many guests, some to meet their fortunes, and others to meet their doom.
column2: 你们离开岛屿时，Byrne 回到了 Frico 手下。\n\n此后许多年，他都安静地照吩咐去做，给 Frico 带来许多客人，有的去赴自己的好运，有的去赴自己的末日。

column1: Byrne wasn't particularly interested in leaving Lukatt, so when the boat left, he stayed behind.\n\nHe haunts the woodlands of Knightwood still, preying on the wildlife and unsuspecting travelers as it suits him, and relishing his freedom.
column2: Byrne 对离开卢卡特并没有多大兴趣，所以船一走，他就留了下来。\n\n他至今仍在骑士林的林地里出没，看自己的心情捕食野兽和毫无防备的旅人，享受着这份自由。

column1: After arriving in Tsarath, Logus contacted a few people who had heard of him, and managed to get signed on with a privateering crew as a ship's mate.\n\nHe wasn't thrilled about having to take orders from someone else, but given the choice, he decided that it was more worth it to be out on the water than not, and as far as you know, he is still with that crew, running odd shipments for merchant houses.
column2: 到了察拉思之后，Logus 联系了几个听说过他的人，设法签约加入一支私掠船员，当上了大副。\n\n要听别人的号令，他并不痛快。但两相比较，他认定能出海总比不能出海更值得。据你所知，他至今还在那支船员里，替各家商号跑些零星的货。

column1:
Logus stuck close to you when you arrived in Tsarath. He still had sympathetic contacts there, so he managed to find you shelter and work early on, and generally made the transition to your new surroundings much more agreeable.

After a time, he began to feel the call of the sea once again, so he pulled some strings and eventually got put in charge of another ship working for a private merchant corps.

He still tries to stay in touch with you when he can, but he is happy to be back in his element.
column2:
你们到察拉思的时候，Logus 紧紧跟在你身边。他在当地还有几个肯帮他的旧相识，所以很早就替你找到了住处和工作，让你适应新环境的过程顺畅了许多。

过了一段时间，他再次感到大海在召唤，于是托了些关系，最终负责起另一艘为私人商团效力的船。

他仍会在能联系的时候跟你保持联络，但能回到自己最自在的地方，他很高兴。

column1:
Grant was reluctant to board the ship at first, but after a heart-to-heart talk, he decided that he could always return later, and nervously left his homeland behind him.

More than able to keep pace with the orcs of Tsarath in terms of physical strength, he busied himself with being generally helpful, and eventually made himself a fixture on the docks in the town where you landed.

He often wondered aloud about how long he should stay and about what he would say to his father when he went home, but one day, one of the other workers at the dock confessed to having feelings for him, and the talk of going home disappeared overnight.

They live together now in a cabin they built themselves, and Grant's gruff demeanor seems to have softer corners.
column2:
Grant 起初不愿意上船。一次推心置腹的谈话之后，他认定自己以后随时可以回来，这才忐忑地离开了故乡。

论体力，他完全跟得上察拉思的兽人，甚至还绰绰有余。他到处忙着帮忙，最终成了你们登陆的那座城镇码头上少不了的人。

他常常大声琢磨自己该留多久，回家时又该对父亲说些什么。可有一天，码头上另一名工人向他表白了心意，回家这个话题一夜之间就消失了。

如今他们住在两人自己动手盖的小木屋里，Grant 那副粗声粗气的脾性，棱角似乎也软了。

column1:
Disgusted with your broken promise, Grant left your company as soon as you made it clear that you would be leaving the island.

Rather than face the shame of returning to Hayill empty-handed, Grant gathered up a few of his werewolf friends and staged an assault of his own on Frico's castle.

Many on both sides were slain, including Grant himself, but Frico survived, and declared open war on the island's lycanthropes.

The Knightwood region is now a deadly warzone, with fangs and claws lashing out from behind every shadow, and until one side is exterminated, it seems likely to stay that way.
column2:
你背弃了诺言，Grant 厌恶至极。你一表明要离开这座岛，他就离开了你的队伍。

他不愿空手回到海伊尔去面对那种耻辱，便叫上几个狼人朋友，自己对 Frico 的城堡发动了袭击。

双方死了不少人，Grant 自己也在其中。Frico 却活了下来，并向岛上的狼人族公开宣战。

骑士林地区如今成了致命的战区，每一道影子后面都有尖牙和利爪猛地挥出。在有一方被灭绝之前，看来会一直如此。

column1:
Grant returned to Hayill to share in the celebrations over the death of Frico.

With the vampire lord vanquished, Hayill quickly became the dominant power on the island, and set up a rogue coalition between the most prominent towns.

Grant is still there, his heroic deed done, watching the development of the island from the front line.
column2:
Grant 回到海伊尔，去分享庆祝 Frico 之死的喜悦。

吸血鬼领主被消灭之后，海伊尔很快成为岛上的主导势力，并让几座最主要的城镇结成了一个不受管束的联盟。

Grant 还在那里。他的英雄之举已经做完，人在前线看着这座岛的发展。

column1:
Satisfied to be out of immediate danger, Greave soon made arrangements to return to the Crest mainland and report on what he had seen.

He seemed confident that use of the stocks would cease once it became clear that escape was now possible, but when he tried to inform people what had happened, he was quickly tried as a deserter and found guilty.

He is now interned somewhere on the mainland.
column2:
脱离了眼前的危险，Greave 感到满意，很快就安排返回克雷斯特大陆，汇报自己的所见所闻。

他似乎确信，一旦大家明白如今已经逃得掉，枷场就不会再启用。可当他试图把发生的事告诉人们时，很快就被当作逃兵审判，并被判有罪。

他如今被拘禁在大陆的某处。

column1:
Knowing that returning to Crest would be the end of him, Greave instead tried to get the word out about the atrocities of the island by notifying the Tsarathi authorities through anonymous missives.

When the authorities failed to do anything about it, he took on the moniker "Crowquill" and began distributing stories of events on the island to the public at large, leaving them in busy places and generally making himself impossible to find.

Though nothing has been done in an official capacity, he buries a wry smile in his beard as he hears customers gossiping about his latest pages at the smithy where he works, and people have begun independantly copying and spreading his work around.

Eventually, he tells you, something will snap.
column2:
Greave 知道回到克雷斯特就是自己的死期，于是改用匿名信件通知察拉思当局，想把岛上那些暴行传出去。

当局什么也没做。他便用上了“Crowquill”这个名号，开始向公众散发岛上事件的故事，把它们留在人来人往的地方，同时让自己根本无法被找到。

官方始终毫无动作。可当他在自己干活的铁匠铺里听见顾客议论他最新的篇页时，他把一丝讥诮的笑埋进了胡子里。人们已经开始自行抄写，把他的文字散布出去。

他告诉你，迟早会有什么东西绷断。

column1:
Greening faced some significant culture shock when trying to integrate into Tsarathi life, finding little demand for his passionately-produced pastries.

Settling for crafts gradually further and further from his heart, he eventually found a place in a butcher, where his careful eye for detail goes largely unappreciated.

He gives away his conjured cookies for free, hoping they will catch on, but so far the only real demand comes from odd gangs of poor children.
column2:
Greening 试图融入察拉思的生活，却碰上了不小的文化冲击。他倾注热情做出来的糕点，几乎没有人要。

他只好一步步退让，去做离自己心意越来越远的手艺，最终在一家肉铺里找了个位置。他那双讲究细节的眼睛，在那里基本上无人赏识。

他把用法术变出来的饼干免费送人，希望能流行起来。可到目前为止，真正想要的只有几帮古怪的穷孩子。

column1:
Not finding much demand for his pastries in Tsarath, Greening was nonetheless determined to make an impression on his stubborn orc hosts.

He shifted his focus onto grilling, and through practice and arcane taboo, he was soon able to serve up a rack of barbequed ribs that even an ogre would swoon over.

He now wages open war against empty orc bellies in his popular grill pit, where he serves strong sauce and stronger beer, and to his delight, he even manages to move a few baskets of butter biscuits now and then.
column2:
糕点在察拉思没什么销路，Greening 却仍然决心给这些固执的兽人东道主留个印象。

他把心思转到了烧烤上。靠着反复练习和奥术禁忌，他很快就能端出一架连食人魔都会为之倾倒的烤肋排。

如今他在自己那口大受欢迎的烤坑里，向空空的兽人肚子公开宣战。他供应浓烈的酱汁，还有更烈的啤酒，而且令他高兴的是，黄油饼干时不时也能卖掉几篮。

column1: Used to being surrounded by humans, Kirilo was was accustomed to being stronger than his peers, but in Tsarath where competition for status is fierce, he found himself to be actually quite slight in comparison to his fellow orcs.\n\nWhen trying to stop a thief in the market one day, he found himself hopelessly outmatched, and was badly beaten. In the weeks that followed, poor medical care resulted in his condition worsening, and he spent his final night alone in an alley in an impoverished slum, his spirit as broken as his body.
column2: Kirilo 习惯了身边都是人类，也习惯了自己比同辈更壮。可在察拉思，争地位争得厉害，他发现跟其他兽人一比，自己其实相当单薄。\n\n有一天，他想在集市上截住一个小偷，却发现自己完全不是对手，被打得极惨。其后几周，糟糕的医治让伤势越来越重。他在贫民窟的一条小巷里独自过了最后一夜，精神碎得和身体一样。

column1:
Kirilo, feeding his ever-present need to fight for the downtrodden, found his place in Tsarath at one of the many orphanages, where his kind and selfless attitude was quickly appreciated.

He earns coin by working as a runner most days, and then returns home to his boys and to a gaffer who is growing more fond of him by the day.

It isn't nearly as dramatic a life as he is used to, but he concedes that perhaps he has had enough life and death drama for one lifetime, and seems content to settle down.
column2:
顺着那股从来没断过的、要替受压迫者出头的劲，Kirilo 在察拉思的许多孤儿院里挑了一所安身。他那善良无私的态度很快就得到了赏识。

他大多数日子靠跑腿挣钱，然后回家，回到他的男孩们身边，也回到一个一天比一天更疼他的老头身边。

这种生活远不如他过惯的那般惊心动魄，但他也承认，也许这一辈子的生死戏剧已经够他受了，似乎也乐意就此安顿下来。

column1:
Leftie was helpful and enthusiastic about repairing the boat, but on the morning you were ready to leave, he told you he wouldn't be coming.

Still unwilling to speak of his crimes, he only said that he was better off on Lukatt, and would not be dissuaded.

He wished you well and stood on the beach as you left, waving you off, and that was the last you ever saw or heard of him.
column2:
Leftie 修船时又热心又起劲，可你们准备离开的那天早上，他告诉你他不走了。

他仍然不愿谈自己的罪行，只说留在卢卡特对他更好，怎么劝也不听。

他祝你一切顺利，站在海滩上，在你们离开时挥手送别。那是你最后一次见到他，也是最后一次听到他的消息。

column1:
Initially, Leftie did not want to get on the boat, claiming that it was better for him to just stay and be forgotten.

When you tried to convince him, he got agitated, and you fought in the sand.

You punched him and told him you weren't leaving him behind, and he held you and wept, with the rest of your band awkwardly trying not to stare.

Before long, you were gliding out to sea with Leftie by your side, his swollen black eye shining with appreciation.
column2:
起初 Leftie 不想上船。他说，自己还是留下来、被人忘掉更好。

你试图劝他的时候，他激动起来，你们在沙地上打了一架。

你揍了他一拳，告诉他你不会把他丢下。他抱住你哭了，团伙里其余的人尴尬地尽量不去看。

没过多久，你们就滑向海上，Leftie 在你身边，他那只肿起的乌青眼闪着感激。

column1:
In the years thet followed, Leftie was always close by, backing your every move and decision, and he never forgot that you were the one who had faith in him even when he had none in himself.

He seemed wholly unbothered by a life of hard labour in his new home among the orcs of Tsarath, and he made a point of living somewhere nearby, and scarcely went more than a few days without at least stopping in to see how you were doing.

Though he always had a quick temper, he was also loyal and quick to forgive, and you never observed Leftie to be the monster he claimed to be.
column2:
此后的岁月里，Leftie 始终在近旁，支持你的每一个行动、每一个决定。他从未忘记：哪怕他对自己毫无信心的时候，对他有信心的那个人也是你。

在察拉思的兽人中间过艰苦的劳作日子，他似乎完全不放在心上。他特意住在附近，很少会隔上几天还不至少登门看看你过得怎么样。

他脾气虽然来得快，却也忠诚，原谅得也快。在你眼中，Leftie 从来不是他自称的那种怪物。

column1: Moria left after your battle with Leviathan was over, saying she had no interest in going back to the mainland.\n\nShe packed up her meager things and headed off into the wilds of Lukatt alone, where she takes great satisfaction in her daily struggles to survive.
column2: 和 Leviathan 的战斗结束之后，Moria 就离开了。她说自己对回大陆毫无兴趣。\n\n她收拾起那点微薄的行李，独自走进卢卡特的荒野。每天为活下去而挣扎，让她感到极大的满足。

column1:
Although she had no love for the idea of returning to civilization, you managed to convince Moria that Tsarath would offer ample opportunities for a survivalist lifestyle, and she agreed to make the journey with you.

Nearly immediately upon arrival, she set out for Tsarath's rugged tundra frontiers, and took up company with a band of loosely-affiliated nomads, moving from place to place as the seasons turned, and earning their living by the sweat of their labour.

You only saw her once after that, but she was still strong, healthy, and glad to be living a life that she felt she had properly earned.
column2:
她虽然一点也不喜欢回到文明世界这个主意，你还是说服了她：在察拉思，靠自己拼命活下去的日子大有机会。她同意跟你一起走。

几乎一到，她就动身前往察拉思崎岖的苔原边疆，与一帮联系松散的游牧民结了伴。他们随季节迁徙，靠劳作流下的汗水谋生。

那之后你只见过她一次。她依然强壮、健康，并且高兴自己过上了她觉得是实打实挣来的生活。

column1:
Nazar was obviously distressed at the idea of going back to Tsarath, but he held your hand tightly as the view of the island grew distant across the water.

When you arrived at the mainland, he was surprised to find the Tsarathi commonfolk showing a great deal of support and sympathy for those bearing the scapegoat brand.

Without the need to live a secluded life, Nazar became a social member of the rural community where the two of you lived, and you were eventually married in a small temple, according to Tsarathi traditions.

You live together in a cottage that you built with help from your neighbors, and your life is both simple and fulfilling.
column2:
一想到要回察拉思，Nazar 显然十分不安，可岛的影子在水面那边越来越远时，他紧紧握着你的手。

你们抵达大陆之后，他惊讶地发现，察拉思的平民对带着替罪羊烙印的人表现出极大的支持与同情。

不必再离群索居，Nazar 成了你们所住的那个乡村社群里爱跟人来往的一员。最终，你们按照察拉思的传统，在一座小神庙里结为夫妻。

你们一起住在邻居帮忙盖起的村舍里，生活既简单，又充实。

column1: Nazar helped you make preparations for the trip, but refused to return to Tsarath, saying he preferred to remain on Lukatt instead.\n\nHe went to Greenback Bay, where he found himself high in demand on labour teams and guard teams, as well as in the arms of lonely castaways, and is as happy there as he has ever been.
column2: Nazar 帮你准备了这次行程，却拒绝回察拉思。他说自己更想留在卢卡特。\n\n他去了绿背湾，劳作队抢着要他，守卫队抢着要他，孤独的流落者的怀抱也抢着要他，他在那里过得比以往任何时候都快活。

column1:
Torn between his dislike of Tsarathi laws and the idea of losing you to them, Nazar nervously accompanied you back to the mainland.

Though he had grown up in one of the Tsarathi military schools, he had no family to speak of and no real place to go back to, so he stuck close by your side, an obvious affection for you shining through his every move.

He was eventually able to find steady work as woodsman, and made his permanent home as close to you as he could manage.

Indeed, it became hard to remember a time when Nazar's affection and support were not a constant feature of your life.
column2:
一边厌恶察拉思的法律，一边又怕这些法律把你从他身边夺走，Nazar 夹在中间，还是紧张地陪你回到了大陆。

他虽在一所察拉思军校里长大，却说不上有什么家人，也没有真正能回去的地方，于是紧紧守在你身边，一举一动都明显透着对你的爱意。

他最终找到了稳定的樵夫活，并把长住的家安在自己能做到的、离你最近的地方。

后来你已经很难想起，生活里曾有哪一段没有 Nazar 的爱意和支持相伴。

column1: Paul was happy to have been helpful with your survival, but he mostly got in the way when it came to repairing the boat, and he eventually decided that his time with you was at an end.\n\nHe made a home for himself near Spartill Lodge, where he continues to work the forests for anyone willing to pay him for his time.
column2: Paul 很高兴自己帮你活了下来，可一到修船，他多半净是碍事。他最终认定，和你相处的日子到此为止了。\n\n他在斯帕蒂尔旅舍附近安了家，继续给任何肯花钱买他时间的人在林子里干活。

column1:
Paul was excited to be part of all the activity surrounding your departure, and it wasn't until you were out at sea already that he started having second thoughts.

You managed to talk him down, however, and when you finally arrived in Tsarath, Paul drew less attention than he had expected.

Though not exactly common, many of the people there had seen their share of giants already, and when he made himself available for labour jobs, he quickly found himself with as much work as he could handle.

Being part of a community was a new experience for Paul, but he found it to his liking, and he soon moved into a permanent home of his own construction in a small frontier town, where he remains busy and content.
column2:
Paul 很兴奋，你动身前后的种种忙乱他都想掺一脚。直到已经出了海，他才起了退意。

不过你把他劝了下来。等你们终于到了察拉思，Paul 引起的注意比他预想的少。

虽然巨人在那里不算常见，许多人却已经见过不少。他一说自己可以接劳作的活，很快就有了满满当当、他刚好还能应付的工作。

成为一群人中的一员，对 Paul 是头一遭，但他发现自己喜欢这样。不久，他在一座边疆小镇住进了自己亲手盖的家，打算长住，在那里一直忙碌，也一直满足。

column1:
Once you arrived in Tsarath, Peregrine began burgling again almost immediately.

He quickly found, however, that without his previous network of contacts, the profession was much more dangerous than he was accustomed to, and a persistent manhunt for him has been on ever since his first heist.

His life is spent nervously hiding from bootsteps in mouldering hovels and sleeping with one eye open.
column2:
你们一到察拉思，Peregrine 几乎马上又干起了入室行窃。

可他很快发现，没有从前那张关系网，这行比他习惯的危险得多。从第一桩窃案起，一场没完没了的追捕就一直盯着他。

他的日子就是在霉烂的破屋里神经紧张地躲皮靴声，睡觉也只敢睁着一只眼。

column1:
Peregrine had previously spent a great deal of time working as a sailor as a cover for his burgling, and he took your move to Tsarath as an opportunity to embrace that work full-time.

It didn't take him long to secure a position working on a merchant ship, and he is now well-paid to make shipping runs back and forth for some of the very people he used to burgle.

Though he sometimes complains that he misses the excitement, he adds that not having to constantly look over his shoulder and fear for his safety is a nice perk, and he seems content in the choices he has made.

Whenever he is in port, he makes a point of checking up on you and stopping by to share a bottle of whatever expensive liquor he has managed to stow away.
column2:
Peregrine 从前长期以当水手作为入室行窃的掩护。你搬到察拉思，他便当成了把水手这行全职干起来的机会。

没过多久，他就在一艘商船上谋到了差事。如今报酬优厚，他来回跑船，替一些人运货，而那些人里就有他从前下手偷过的。

他有时抱怨自己怀念那种刺激，可他又说，不用成天回头看、不用为自家小命提心吊胆，倒是个不错的甜头。他似乎对自己的选择很满意。

每次进港，他都特意来看你，带上一瓶他设法藏下来的昂贵酒，跟你一起把那瓶酒喝了。

column1:
Rangda refused to return to Tsarath, and left your company as soon as you found the boat.

She eventually made her way to Marsaven on the southeast side of the island and decided to settle in, but has had difficulty making friends, as many of the people there have little patience for her attitude.

She is still finding herself, but does not regret leaving her old life behind.
column2:
Rangda 拒绝回察拉思。你一找到船，她就离开了你的队伍。

她最终去了岛东南侧的马尔萨文，决定住下来，但交朋友很困难。那里许多人对她的态度没什么耐心。

她仍在寻找自我，但并不后悔把旧生活抛在身后。

column1:
She deliberated on the issue for quite a while, but ultimately, Rangda decided to remain on Lukatt instead of returning to Tsarath, knowing that she would eventually be subject to the familiar confines of the law once again.

She saw you off on the beach and then made her way to Marsaven, where she worked hard to prove herself to the people there and integrate into the community, and eventually became a guardsman.

Life on Lukatt isn't easy for her, but when she wakes up and straps on her uniform each day, she feels as though she's made the right decision.
column2:
这件事她斟酌了很久。最终 Rangda 还是决定留在卢卡特，不回察拉思。她知道，自己迟早会再次落到法律那套熟悉的约束里。

她在海滩上送走了你，然后前往马尔萨文。她在那里努力向当地人证明自己，融入社群，最终当上了卫兵。

卢卡特的生活对她并不轻松。可每天醒来、扣上制服的时候，她都觉得这个决定是对的。

column1:
Rosaline seemed to be nervous about making the journey to Tsarath, and so she ultimately decided to stay on Lukatt.

She said that there would be other boats eventually, since the seas had been calmed, and that she wanted time to think about what her next move would be.

She ended up going to the Pumphouse Brewery in the Bracewind region and entertaining guests who were accustomed to long waiting periods.
column2:
Rosaline 似乎对去察拉思的旅程感到紧张，最终决定留在卢卡特。

她说，大海既然已经平静，以后总会有别的船，而她想要时间想想下一步该怎么走。

她最后去了布雷斯温德地区的泵房酿酒坊，给那些习惯了长时间等候的客人助兴。

column1:
Upon arriving in Tsarath, Rosaline did exactly what she said she would do; she found herself a bawdy, bustling tavern and refused to leave until they hired her on as a dancer.

More than capable of handling herself in a rough crowd, she now dances burlesque to the delight of throngs of merrily drunken orcs, and finds herself rather fond of the attention she gets.

She now makes plenty enough coin in tips to clothe herself in lavish silks and fine jewelry, and has a long list of devoted admirers.
