She still worries that someday her old troupe will catch up with her, but for the time being, she is meeting life head-on and having a lot of fun in the process.
column2:
一到察拉思，Rosaline 就完全照她说过的做了。她找了一家下流又热闹的酒馆，不肯离开，直到他们雇她当舞者。

粗野的人群她完全应付得来。如今她跳着艳舞，取悦成群喝得正欢的兽人，而且发现自己相当喜欢这种关注。

她现在光靠小费就挣得够多，足以用华丽的丝绸和精美的珠宝装扮自己，还有一长串死心塌地的仰慕者。

她仍担心有一天旧剧团会追上她。但眼下，她正迎头面对生活，并且在这个过程中玩得非常开心。

column1: Shapiro found acceptance in Tsarath almost immediately, offering his services to a cabal of independant sorcerers.\n\nFinding their rules much less restrictive than those of the Crest guilds he was used to, he merrily buries himself in research and experimentation, earning a more or less honest wage, and swearing that he should have come to Tsarath years ago.
column2: Shapiro 几乎立刻就在察拉思得到了接纳。他把自己的本事献给了一伙独立巫师组成的秘社。\n\n他发现这里的规矩比他待惯的克雷斯特公会松得多，于是愉快地埋头研究和实验，挣着一份大体还算老实的工钱，并发誓自己几年前就该来察拉思。

column1:
When you arrived, Shapiro began to go through some old guild contacts he had, and quickly found himself a fairly discreet position in a Tsarathi guild sect.

Though the facilities are not as convenient as he was previously used to, he found the differences in approach and attitude to be both fascinating and liberating, and manages to conduct his research more freely than before.

He is currently mentoring several young orcs as apprentices, and on the rare occasion when you see him, he speaks of them incessantly.

He is often critical of their progress, but he is clearly glad to have students once again, and overall he seems happy with his life.
column2:
你们抵达之后，Shapiro 开始翻找他在旧行会的人脉，很快就在察拉思的一个行会支派里谋到了一份相当不显眼的差事。

设施不如他从前习惯的那般便利，但这里在做法和态度上的差异既让他着迷，也让他感到解脱，研究做得比以前更自由。

眼下他正带几名年轻兽人做学徒。难得见到他时，他会不停地念叨他们。

他常常挑剔他们的进度，但显然很高兴又能有学生。总的来说，他似乎对自己的生活很满意。

column1:
Vankan was nigh inconsolable after the death of Leviathan, sobbing for hours on end.

For whatever reason, he seemed to have been damaged directly by the divine beast's death, and he crawled back into the Bath alone, prostrating himself before Leviathan's body and begging the heavens for forgiveness.

You gave him some time, but he told you to leave him there, and eventually you were forced to do exactly that.

He did not follow you or turn up at your stronghold later, and you do not know what happened to him.
column2:
Leviathan 死后，Vankan 悲痛得几乎无法安慰，一连哭了好几个小时。

不知为何，他似乎被这头神兽的死直接伤到了。他独自爬回 Bath，在 Leviathan 的遗体前匍匐跪倒，祈求上天宽恕。

你给了他一些时间，可他让你把他留在那里，最终你只好照办。

他没有跟你走，后来也没出现在你的据点。你不知道他怎么样了。

column1:
Vankan was nearly catatonic with grief after you emerged from the Bath. You spent a lot of time comforting him and helping him work through it, and when you finally concluded that Vankan's third eye had made him particularly sensitive to the divine beast's death, he became suddenly very eager to leave the island.

He seemed to practically hold his breath for the entire effort of the ship repair, and when you were finally out at sea with the island far behind you, he laid down on the deck and slept peacefully for the first time in weeks.

Vankan eventually found a place as a healer in a small town with a need of one, his unique gift making him a popular man for setting minds at ease as well as mending bodies. Over time, he has found his visions easier to translate into sensible advice, and he is pleased to finally have found a sense of normalcy.
column2:
你们从 Bath 出来后，Vankan 悲伤得近乎呆滞。你花了很长时间安慰他，陪他把这事熬过去。等你终于认定，是 Vankan 的第三只眼让他对这头神兽的死格外敏感时，他忽然急切地想离开这座岛。

整段修船的工夫里，他简直像一直屏着呼吸。等到你们终于出海、把岛远远抛在身后，他躺到甲板上，几个星期来头一次安稳地睡着了。

Vankan 后来在一座正缺治疗师的小镇落了脚。他那份独特的天赋让他很受欢迎，既能安抚人心，也能为人疗伤。日子久了，他发现自己更容易把幻象说成明白的忠告，也很高兴终于找回一点寻常的生活。

column1:
Wisaka was leery of the expedition, knowing that lycanthropes are often hunted and killed in mainland communities, so he ultimately decided to remain on the island.

Though he considered going to Hayill, he didn't much care for their ongoing struggle with the Knightwood vampires, so he instead headed for Bracewind and hired on at the Pumphouse Brewery.

Now he plays music for patrons, earning his way in tips, and occasionally taking adventuresome clients of his own.
column2:
Wisaka 对这次远行心存戒备。他知道狼人族在大陆的聚落里常常遭到猎杀，所以最终决定留在岛上。

他考虑过去海伊尔，却不大想掺和他们同骑士林吸血鬼之间那场没完的争斗，于是转而去了布雷斯温德，在泵房酿酒坊受雇干活。

如今他给酒客奏乐，靠小费过活，偶尔也自己带上爱冒险的客人出去走一遭。

column1:
Whether because of his daring or because of his naivete, Wisaka was enthusiastic about the trip to the mainland, and indeed, when he arrived, he made a spectacle of himself almost immediately.

Unsure how to react at first, a shocked crowd gathered as Wisaka began to sing and play music, and by the time the guards arrived to see what the commotion was, people were cheering and throwing him spare coins.

He now has a sort of probationary allowance to live and work in town, and he takes full advantage of it, cheerfully socializing with the locals and frequently answering invitations to perform, as curious crowds from far and wide whisper wild rumours of "The Howling Bard".
column2:
无论是因为胆大还是因为天真，Wisaka 对去大陆都兴致勃勃。他一到那儿，果然几乎立刻就把自己弄成了一场热闹。

Wisaka 开始又唱又奏，人群起初不知该如何反应，只是震惊地围上来。等卫兵赶来查看骚动时，人们已经在欢呼，并把零钱朝他扔去。

如今他得到一种试用性质的许可，可以在城里生活和工作。他把这许可用了个够，乐呵呵地同本地人来往，也常常应邀演出。远近好奇的人群都在悄悄流传关于“嚎月诗人”的荒唐传闻。

column1:
Zantanak cloaked himself in dark cloth and remained your servant and bodyguard once you arrived in Tsarath.

With his guidance, you were eventually able to find the headquarters of a small cult that you readily impressed into your service.

He is a constant voice, ever urging you to gather more power, more followers, and more forbidden knowledge.
column2:
你们抵达察拉思之后，Zantanak 用黑布裹住自己，继续当你的仆从和保镖。

在他的指引下，你终于找到一个小教团的总部，并且轻而易举地让他们为你效力。

他的声音从不间断，一直催你去聚敛更多力量、更多追随者，以及更多禁忌的知识。

column1:
Though he did not relish the idea of covering his face and body, Zantanak put on a low profile once you arrived in Tsarath, and did his best not to cause you undue trouble.

At his direction, you found the headquarters of a small cult and readily convinced them to serve you, eventually forming a small community where Zantanak hides his face only from outside visitors.

Eventually, once your commune was well-established, he asked for your permission to take a harem, and seeing that there were several cultists eager to fill the role, you allowed it.

He is nearly as protective of his wives as he is of you, and he is a much feared, respected, and admired member of your growing faith.
column2:
尽管并不乐意遮住脸和身体，Zantanak 在你们抵达察拉思后还是收敛了行迹，尽力不给你添不必要的麻烦。

在他的指点下，你找到一个小教团的总部，并顺利说服他们侍奉你，最终形成了一处小聚落。在那里，Zantanak 只对外来的访客遮住面孔。

后来，等你的聚居地站稳了，他请求你允许他纳一组后宫。你见有好几名教徒急着来充当这个角色，便应允了。

他护着那些妻子的劲头几乎不亚于护着你。在你日益壮大的信仰里，他是一个令人畏惧、受人尊敬、也受人仰慕的成员。

column1: Your level has increased!\nSpend available skill points before moving on.
column2: 你的等级提升了！\n请先分配可用的技能点，再继续。

column1: Press and Hold to Load File
Captain Logus said his boat was hidden near Forfshire Overwatch. We should meet him there as soon as we're ready to get off this rock.
column2: “Logus 船长说他的船藏在福夫郡瞭望台附近。等我们准备好离开这块破石头，就该去那儿跟他会合。”

column1: What are we waiting for? Let's meet the Captain at Forfshire Overwatch and get off this rock for good!
column2: “还等什么？去福夫郡瞭望台跟船长会合，从此离开这块破石头！”

column1: We're finally leaving, are we? It's been so long. Captain Logus said he'd meet us at Forfshire Overwatch when we're ready to go.
column2: “我们终于要走了，是吗？都这么久了。Logus 船长说，等我们准备好出发，他就在福夫郡瞭望台跟我们会合。”

column1: All that work for nothing. What a miserable attempt that was. Maybe there'll be something helpful in that old book, at least. Have you found anyone who can read it yet?
column2: “白忙一场。这次尝试可真够惨的。至少那本旧书里也许有点用得上的东西。你找到能读懂它的人了吗？”

column1: What a rotten waste, and for what? A soggy old book? Maybe if we find someone who can actually read the damn thing, it'll give us some idea what to do.
column2: “真是糟蹋，图什么？一本湿透的旧书？要是能找到真正读得懂这鬼东西的人，也许就知道下一步该怎么办。”

column1: That's just great. And here I thought we were finally getting somewhere! All we've got to show for it is some crummy book we can't even read!
column2: “可真行。我还以为咱们终于有点进展了！到头来就剩下一本连读都读不懂的破书！”

column1: I can't imagine the Queen would have kept such important secrets anyplace in the royal court. It seems far too obvious. Did she have some other favorite refuge?
column2: “我没法想象女王会把这么重要的秘密放在宫廷里的任何地方。那也太显眼了。她有没有别的什么偏爱的避居之处？”

column1: Let me tell you, if I was hiding such important secrets, I wouldn't have hid them under my ass in the capital. Perhaps the Queen had some other, more private place she might have hidden something.
column2: “跟你说，我要是藏这么重要的秘密，可不会藏在首都、我的屁股底下。女王也许另有一处更隐秘的地方，能藏点东西。”

column1: Someplace important to the royal family, but also someplace private enough not to be seen by lots of people. Is there anyplace else in the Caldera that the Queen might have spent a lot of time?
column2: “得是对王室要紧的地方，又得足够私密，不至于被很多人看见。在破火山口里，还有没有别的地方是女王可能常待的？”

column1: Well, the Prime Minster had a place down south, didn't he? And Spartill's hunting lodge is out east. Seems like we're bound to find at least a few clues if we search those areas.
column2: “嗯，首相在南边有一处地方，对吧？Spartill 的狩猎小屋在东边。我们去那些地方搜一搜，肯定能找到至少几条线索。”

column1: I think it says something that we haven't seen any statues of this Fastad fellow. You can search his archive if you want, but if you ask me, Spartill is the fellow to be chasing. I'd go to his lodge to look for more clues.
column2: “咱们连这个 Fastad 家伙的一座雕像都没见过，这就说明点问题。你想搜他的档案室就去搜，可要我说，该追的是 Spartill。我会去他的小屋找更多线索。”

column1: Maxim Spartill was the Queen's lover, wasn't he? She obviously trusted him a great deal, so perhaps there are further clues to be found in his lodge. I'm not sure how I feel about this Fastad fellow, though. Something about him doesn't sit right.
column2: “Maxim Spartill 是女王的情人，对吧？她显然非常信任他，所以他的小屋里也许还能找到更多线索。至于这个 Fastad 家伙，我说不好。他身上有什么地方让我不踏实。”

column1: How on earth are we supposed to know what the Babe is? Is it an animal? Or a place? It seems important, but Spartill didn't give us a lot to go on.
column2: “我们到底该怎么知道 Babe 是什么？是动物？还是地方？它看起来很重要，可 Spartill 没给我们多少线索。”

column1: We need to find whatever Spartill was after. That means figuring out what the Babe is and how to reach it.
column2: “我们得找到 Spartill 在追的东西。也就是弄清 Babe 是什么，以及怎么到那儿去。”

column1: I wonder what Spartill was expecting to find by chasing this Babe? I suppose if we're going after him, we might soon find out.
column2: “不知道 Spartill 追着这个 Babe，是指望找到什么？我想我们要是去追他，也许很快就能知道。”

column1: You've got some stones if you're going to go exploring a place like Bath Polyandrium. Makes me glad I just pour drinks and babysit crates.
column2: “你可真有种，敢去浴场合葬墓那种地方探险。我可高兴了，我只要倒酒、看着那些箱子就行。”

column1: Whatever's in Bath Polyandrium is probably what Spartill was looking for. Make sure you and your friends are well prepared for whatever's in there.
column2: “浴场合葬墓里的东西，大概就是 Spartill 在找的。你和你的朋友可得做好准备，应付里面的任何东西。”

column1: Bath Polyandrium is the tomb of King Chevre, the first king of Lukatt. God knows what you're going to find down there. Be careful.
column2: “浴场合葬墓是卢卡特第一位国王 Chevre 的陵墓。天知道你在下面会找到什么。小心。”

column1: A ship at Greenback Bay? I suppose if there'd be one anyplace, that's where I'd look first.
column2: “绿背湾有船？我想要是哪儿有船，我也会先去那儿找。”

column1: A seaworthy ship on an island like this will be no small surprise, but Greenback Bay is as good a place to start the search as any.
column2: “在这种岛上找到一艘能出海的船，可不是小事。不过要开始找，绿背湾跟别处一样合适。”

column1: So we're shooting for Greenback Bay, are we? Do you really think there's going to be ship there? Seems to me that any seaworthy ship would've left this place long ago.
column2: “所以我们的目标是绿背湾，是吗？你真觉得那儿会有船？依我看，任何能出海的船早就离开这地方了。”

column2: 风险为零！行动时按住 SHIFT，可以多出一个回合！

column2: 按住 F1 查看综合帮助

Press and hold F1 or H for detailed information.

column2: 你可以让新成员在入口等候，也可以让其立即加入队伍。

column2: 队伍已满，新成员会在入口等候，直到你准备离开。

column2: 这只生物正在犹豫，但你无法与它沟通。

You can't leave the area while your party is separated!
column2: 队伍走散时，你不能离开这个区域！

column2: 技能说明\n这里会放大量技能信息。

这扇门的门闩已经打开。

column2: 这件事务明显超出你的能力范围，硬来只会让自己受伤。最好让另一个更胜任的人来尝试。

column1: You are in a great deal of pain.
Hire a Quartermaster to improve storage and sell unwanted items.
column2: 雇佣一名军需官，以扩充仓储并出售不需要的物品。

column1: It'll be quite a sight if we manage to actually march twenty strong hands into the Greenback Shipyard like that old captain asked. Do you think he'll keep his end of the bargain?
column2: “要是我们真能照那个老船长说的，把二十名壮劳力开进绿背船厂，那场面可够瞧的。你觉得他会守信用吗？”

column1: I'm not sure how much trust I put in a drunken old sailor on a shipyard pier, but if it's the best lead we've got, I say we round up the twenty hands he asked for and get back to Greenback as soon as possible!
column2: “我不知道该对船厂码头上一个醉醺醺的老水手信任几分，可要是这就是我们最好的线索，我说咱们就把他要的二十名人手凑齐，尽快回绿背！”

column1: Twenty isn't such a high number if you think about it. Just keep at it, one body at a time, and soon we'll have enough hands to impress that old sailor at the Greenback Shipyard.
column2: “仔细想想，二十也不是什么大数目。一个一个地凑，很快我们就有足够的人手，能让绿背船厂那个老水手刮目相看。”

column1: The description of the location. Make this a little bit longer.

column1: Don't stand close to someone with the Unsettling, Nightmarish, or Alluring qualities,\neven if they are allies.

{0}Peering into the bars through a wild shock of hair is the wry face of a young orc. He begins to work the lock open quietly.

"Name's Kirilo. I escaped a while back, but I saw the boat come in, and... well I remember sitting in one of these cells myself, just wishing someone would come and help."

The lock quietly snaps open and the door goes slack. Kirilo, barefoot and dressed in scant more than tatters and a ragged cloak, pushes it open and motions you out into the hall.

"Now the fun starts. You got any tricks up your sleeve I should know about?"
column2:
{0}乱发间探出一张年轻兽人促狭的脸，正透过铁栏往里看。他开始悄悄开锁。

“我叫 Kirilo。我前阵子自己逃出来了，可我看见船靠了岸，就……唉，我也在这种牢房里坐过，那时候只盼着有人来拉一把。”

锁轻轻一弹，门松了。Kirilo 光着脚，身上比破布和一件破烂斗篷多不了多少。他推开门，示意你到走廊里来。

“好戏这才开始。你袖子里有什么本事，是我该知道的？”

column1:
{0}A mountainous orc with a bald head and a neatly-trimmed beard steps up to the bars and begins quietly undoing the lock.

"I am called Nazar, friend. I broke into this place looking for someone, but all I found was this key, and I don't like leaving empty-handed. Lucky for you!"

The door clicks open, and Nazar stands before you, olive-skinned, barrel-chested, and fur-clad.

"You can thank me later. For now, we have to get out of here, and I can't promise it'll be easy. Can you fight if we need to?"
column2:
{0}一个光头、胡须修得齐整、体格像座山的兽人走到铁栏前，开始悄悄开锁。

“朋友，我叫 Nazar。我闯进这儿是来找人的，结果只找到这把钥匙。我可不喜欢空手走。算你走运！”

门咔哒一声开了。Nazar 站在你面前，橄榄色皮肤，胸膛厚实，披着毛皮。

“谢我以后再说。眼下我们得离开这儿，我不敢保证会轻松。真要打，你打得了吗？”

column1:
{0}An athletic man with a bandana tied over his forehead steps up to the bars and begins silently working the lock open. He has a broad grin, but his eyebrows are covered so his expression is difficult to read.

"I broke in to raid their supplies, but they ain't got shit right now. Saw this key on the desk though, and thought a prison break sounded like fun. You agree, of course."

Quiet as a whisper, the door swings open. The man is clearly an accomplished burglar, and seems dressed for the occasion.

"I'm Peregrine, by the way. Ready to roll?"
column2:
{0}一个额头上系着头巾的精壮男人走到铁栏前，开始一声不响地开锁。他笑得很开，可眉毛被挡住了，表情不好判断。

“我进来是想抢他们的补给，可他们现在屁都没有。不过桌上有把钥匙，我觉得越狱听着挺有意思。你当然也这么想。”

门无声地开了。这人显然是个老练的盗贼，一身打扮也像是为此而来。

“对了，我是 Peregrine。可以开溜了吗？”

column1:
{0}A sprightly young woman with a full head of auburn curls steps up to the bars and begins to work the lock.

"You know, I've broken out of a few prisons in my time, but I've got a good feeling about this one. The guards are all morons, as far as I can tell. Also, hi. I'm Rosaline. Come with?"

She pushes the door open as the lock clicks, and motions you out into the hallway. She has the look of a dancer, but it's clear that right now, she isn't fooling around.

"Well, ready to go? Oh wait, please don't tell me that I rescued a baker or something. You can fight or at least hide or something, yeah?"
column2:

“说起来，我这辈子逃出过好几座监狱，可我对这座感觉不错。就我看，守卫全是蠢货。另外，嗨，我是 Rosaline。一起走？”

锁一响，她便推开门，示意你到走廊里来。她看着像个舞者，可这会儿显然不是在闹着玩。

“那么，可以走了吗？哦等等，可别告诉我我救出来的是个面包师什么的。你至少能打，或者能躲，对吧？”

column1:
{0}A man with grizzled hair and a dour expression steps up to the bars and begins to unlock the door.

"I'm Shapiro, a sorcerer. I managed to snag a few keys from guard as he passed by my cell, but there's no telling how long it'll be before they discover something is amiss."

The door swings open gently as the lock is undone. Shapiro is dressed in what must have once have been a grand magister's robe, now soiled and tattered, and he looks very tired.

"We don't have much time, and we'll need some kind of strategy. I can cast some simple spells, but I know nothing of what you can do."
column2:
{0}一个头发花白、神情阴沉的男人走到铁栏前，开始开锁。

“我是 Shapiro，巫师。我从一个路过牢房的守卫身上摸走了几把钥匙，但说不好他们多久会发现不对劲。”

锁一开，门轻轻荡开。Shapiro 穿着一件想必曾经华贵的大法师长袍，如今又脏又破，他看上去非常疲惫。

“我们时间不多，得有个对策。我能放几个简单法术，可我对你能做什么一无所知。”

{0}A very tall orc with a long and well-kept beard steps up to the bars and gets to work unlocking your cell.

"I am Vankan, stranger. I've been here quite some time, but I took advantage of the commotion of the new arrivals to steal some keys. I got the one for my cell, and apparently the one for yours."

The lock clicks and the door swings open, and you can see that Vankan has made an attempt to make himself presentable, despite being clothed in tattered furs.

Out of nowhere, a ferocious current surges and flashes of lightning stab the sky, a jealous force of nature protesting your escape. It is a familiar echo of the night you were first brought to the Stocks.

Logus begins barking orders, but his voice is being drowned out by a furious wind, and your inexperienced crew is quickly overwhelmed.

The waves are growing more violent, and as the ship reels, {0}, {1}, and several others are thrown overboard.

column2: {0}你的普通攻击会使敌人中毒。

column2: {0}你的普通攻击会使敌人陷入剧痛。
{0}你的普通攻击会使敌人眩晕。

column2: {0}你的无辜是力量的源泉。你的生命值上限获得加成。

column1: {0}Sometimes it just gets to be too much and you need to punch something. \nYou deal extra damage with physical attacks.
column2: {0}有时候实在忍无可忍，你就得砸点什么。\n你的物理攻击造成额外伤害。

column1: {0}You know how to stuff your purse, legitimately or otherwise. \nYou gain a small amount of money when attacking enemies.
column2: {0}你知道怎么把钱袋塞满，不管走的是正路还是歪路。\n攻击敌人时，你会得到少量的钱。

column1: {0}You have no respect for any so-called 'God' and you defy the supernatural. \nYou take less damage from magical attacks.
column2: {0}你对任何所谓的“神”毫无敬意，也蔑视超自然之物。\n你受到的魔法攻击伤害更低。

column1: {0}You have no respect for anything weaker than you. \nYour critical hits are more deadly.
column2: {0}你瞧不起任何比你弱的东西。\n你的暴击更加致命。

column1: {0}You know how to work almost any situation to your advantage. \nYou score critical hits more often.
column2: {0}你知道如何让几乎任何局面都变得对自己有利。\n你更常打出暴击。

column1: {0}Your mind is far more vast than any of the simpletons who call you insane could realize. \nYou deal extra damage with magical attacks.
column2: {0}你的心智远比那些骂你疯子的蠢货所能想象的更加广阔。\n你的魔法攻击造成额外伤害。

column1: {0}Your loyalties lie with you alone. You take less damage from physical attacks.
column2: {0}你的忠诚只属于你自己。你受到的物理攻击伤害更低。

column1: {0}Your instincts sometimes get the better of you, but they fuel you endlessly. \nYou regenerate a small amount of hit points each turn.
column2: {0}你的本能有时会反过来支配你，却也源源不断地给你力量。\n每回合你回复少量生命值。

column1: A place that is ever shifting. It's almost as though it's some kind of debug area.
column2: 一个不断变幻的地方。简直像是某种调试区域。

column1: This prison is built inside of an ancient fortress. It was with no small amount of luck that you escaped the grounds, and returning would likely be suicidal.
column2: 这座监狱建在一座古代要塞里面。你能逃出这片场地，靠的是不小的运气，再回去多半是自寻死路。

column1: An opening in the cliff face leads to a twisting tunnel. A way through the mountains, perhaps?
column2: 崖壁上的一个开口通向一条曲折的隧道。也许是穿山而过的路？

column1: A sheltered burrow in the face of the cliff.
column2: 崖壁上一个遮风的洞穴。

column1: The entrance to this place is in poor repair, but it seems as though someone has made an attempt to tidy it up.
column2: 这地方的入口年久失修，但似乎有人试着收拾过。

column1: A lot of info could be stored here. I wonder how much is too much?
column2: 这里能存下大量信息。不知道多少才算太多？

column1: This tomb is deocated in lavish carvings. Judging by the imagery, the person buried here was a blacksmith of some renown.
column2: 这座墓装饰着奢华的雕刻。从图案判断，葬在这里的人是一位颇有名望的铁匠。

column1: A pathway winding through seaside caves. Tidal pools, difficult footing, and a salty chill make this area uninviting.
column2: 一条小路在海边洞穴间蜿蜒。潮池、难行的落脚处，还有咸涩的寒意，让这片区域毫无吸引力。

column1: A small, disused marina. It's a decent enough shelter, but it clearly hasn't been used in a long, long time.
column2: 一座废弃的小码头。作为庇护所倒也凑合，但显然已经很久很久没人用过了。

column1: This grand shipyard must once have produced many fine ships. There are a few husks remaining, some of them still floating.
column2: 这座宏伟的船坞想必曾经造出过许多好船。如今还剩几具船壳，有些仍漂在水上。

column1: A lightly wooded area along the northern edge of the Knightwood forest.
column2: 骑士林森林北缘一片林木稀疏的地带。

column1: A strange golden metal lines the walls of this bizarre tomb. Who knows what you mght encounter inside? Best be well-prepared.
column2: 一座古怪的墓，墙壁上镶着奇怪的金色金属。谁知道里面会碰上什么？最好做好万全准备。

column1: This heavily fortified gate is engraved with many images of diving birds of prey. It looks important.
column2: 这座重兵把守的大门上刻着许多俯冲的猛禽。看上去很重要。

column1: An ancient crypt choked with the scent of stale spices.
column2: 一座古老的地穴，弥漫着陈腐香料的气味。

column1: This crumbling gate is engraved with images depicting a king wielding godlike powers, and his subjects cowering before him.
column2: 这座崩坏的大门上刻着图案：一位国王施展神一般的力量，他的臣民在他面前瑟瑟发抖。

column1: What's left of a modest labour camp set at the foot of the Brad'uk.
column2: 布拉杜克山脚下一座不起眼的劳役营，所剩无几。

column1: An old, sprawling dungeon with some signs of recent activity. Maybe something useful could be found inside.
column2: 一座古老而铺展得很开的地牢，留有一些近期活动的痕迹。也许里面能找到点有用的东西。

column1: This eerie tomb is decorated in dark, disturbing imagery. Who knows what horrors could be waiting inside?
column2: 这座阴森的墓装饰着黑暗、令人不安的图案。谁知道里面可能潜伏着什么恐怖？

column1: A gate marked with morbid imagery. The air is stale and cold.
column2: 一座标着病态图案的门。空气陈腐而寒冷。

column1: This white tower stands on a hidden plateau, nestled within the mountains.
column2: 这座白塔立在群山环抱的一处隐蔽高台上。

column1: This gate is solid, but it feels stately and dignified.
column2: 这扇门很结实，却给人庄重威严的感觉。

column1: The floor and walls have a pulse, and the barely breathable air churns with wet fumes. It's clearly alive, but does it have a mind?
column2: 地板和墙壁都在搏动，几乎无法呼吸的空气里翻涌着潮湿的烟气。它显然是活的，但它有心智吗？

column1: Despite being made of rusted metal panelling, this gate is still very sturdy.
column2: 尽管由生锈的金属板拼成，这扇门依然非常坚固。

column1: These old ruins appear to have been a chapel, once upon a time.
column2: 这些古老的废墟，从前似乎是一座小教堂。

column1: There is a cloud of steam hanging heavy around this place, and the wet air carries an eerie odour.
column2: 这地方周围沉甸甸地笼罩着一团蒸汽，湿空气里带着一股诡异的气味。

column1: There is a cloud of fragrant steam hanging heavy around this place, and the wet air carries an eerie odour.
column2: 这地方周围沉甸甸地笼罩着一团芬芳的蒸汽，湿空气里带着一股诡异的气味。

column1: The ruins of many ships have been crushed together in this hidden cove.
column2: 许多船只的残骸在这处隐蔽的小海湾里挤撞在一起。

column1: There is a great deal of moisture covering the walls and floor of this gate, but it appears to be very solid regardless.
column2: 这扇门的墙壁和地面覆着大量水汽，但尽管如此，它看上去仍非常结实。

column1: A partially-restored town amid the twisted trees of the overgrown Knightwood.
column2: 一座部分修复的城镇，坐落在骑士林那些蔓生、扭曲的树木之间。

column1: This small roadside inn is still in excellent condition. It appears that someone has been tending it.
column2: 这家路边小旅店状况依然极好。看来有人一直在打理它。

column1: Though it is old and rusting, this ironclad bunker is holding up well.
column2: 尽管又旧又在生锈，这座铁甲碉堡依然撑得很好。

column1: The ruins of what must have once been a grand home. There is not much left.
column2: 想必曾是一座宏伟宅邸的废墟。剩下的已经不多了。

column1: The ground surrounding this cabin is warm and black, and there is a heavy smoke hanging in the air.
column2: 这间小屋周围的地面又暖又黑，空气中悬着浓重的烟。

column1: The dust swirls thick about this place, but you can see occasional lights drifting through grimy windows. It is not as empty as it seems.
column2: 这地方尘土浓浓地盘旋，但你能看见偶尔有光从污浊的窗户里飘过。它并不像看上去那么空无一人。

column1: A small camp is set up here. A logging camp, judging by the large number of nearby felled trees.
column2: 这里扎着一座小营地。从附近大量伐倒的树木判断，是一座伐木营。
一间方方正正的大房间。

column1: This opulent, well-maintained manor is easy to spot amid the tangled trees and ruined streets.
column2: 这座奢华、保养良好的庄园，在缠结的树木和残破的街道之间很容易看见。

column1: An ominous door leads to stairs that carry you to a dank dungeon beneath Laughlan Manor.
column2: 一扇不祥的门通向楼梯，把你带到Laughlan庄园底下潮湿的地牢。

column1: Though the signage bears welcoming messages, the architecture of this place is sinister and foreboding. Something is not right here.
column2: 尽管招牌上写着欢迎的字句，这地方的建筑却阴森不祥。这里有什么不对劲。

column1: This place has clearly seen better days. It looks like it could collapse further at any moment.
column2: 这地方显然有过更好的日子。看上去随时可能再塌上一截。

column1: This gate is certainly shut, but it almost seems as though opening it could bring the whole place down. Tread carefully here.
column2: 这扇门确实关着，但几乎让人觉得，打开它就会让整个地方垮下来。在这里走路要小心。

column1: Hot, dry air spills out of the entrance. This promises to be uncomfortable.
column2: 炽热干燥的空气从入口涌出。这里肯定不会舒服。

column1: It is too dark to see what's inside this place, but there is a dark, maleficent energy hanging in the air.
column2: 黑得看不见这地方里面有什么，但空气中悬着一股黑暗而恶毒的能量。

column1: Stairs lead up to these stately loft apartments that have only the slightest lingering scent of blood.
column2: 楼梯通向这些庄严的阁楼公寓，那里只残留着一丝极淡的血腥味。

column1: A dry heat emanates from this sealed gate, and it is difficult to force your lungs to take in the air. Whatever is creating the heat must be behind the gate.
column2: 这扇密封的门散发着干燥的热意，你很难逼自己的肺把这空气吸进去。制造这热意的东西一定在门后。

column1: A sickeningly sweet odour drifts from the entrance of this hidden place.
column2: 一股甜得令人作呕的气味从这处隐秘之地的入口飘来。

column1: A moist, nauseating miasma lingers around the mouth of this ancient gate.
column2: 一团潮湿、令人恶心的瘴气萦绕在这扇古门的门口。

column1: Once long ago, this must have been a well-used trail through the wood. Now it is barely wide enough to walk, choked with trees so thick, you can barely see your next step.
column2: 很久以前，这一定是一条穿过树林、常有人走的小径。如今窄得几乎走不下一个人，树木密得让你几乎看不见下一步落在哪里。

column1: The door to this place opens to reveal a marble temple slick with brine. Tread carefully.
column2: 这地方的门一开，露出一座大理石神殿，表面滑着一层咸水。脚下留神。

column1: This marble gate is covered in barnacles, and the floor is littered with the shells of small ocean life.
column2: 这扇大理石门上长满藤壶，地面散落着小型海洋生物的壳。

column1: This tomb is decorated in lavish carvings. Judging by the imagery, the person buried here was a blacksmith of some renown.
column2: 这座墓装饰着奢华的雕刻。从图案判断，葬在这里的人是一位颇有名望的铁匠。

column1: The ruins of what must have once been a stately abbey. Now the building is cracked and sunken, and the surrounding vegetation appears to be devouring what little is left.
column2: 想必曾是一座庄严修道院的废墟。如今建筑开裂下陷，周围的植物似乎正在吞噬所剩无几的残迹。

column1: An old crumbling fort along the road. It surely has seen better days, but it makes a tempting shelter. No doubt others have also had this thought.
column2: 路边一座正在崩塌的古堡。它当然有过更好的日子，但作为庇护所很有诱惑力。毫无疑问，别人也这么想过。

column1: This garden must have once been quite grand. Now, it is overgrown and dilapidated, like the rest of the island.
column2: 这座花园想必曾经相当宏伟。如今它杂草丛生、破败不堪，和岛上其他地方一样。

column1: This looks like it may once have been a bookseller's shop. It appears to have seen recent use.
column2: 这里看上去也许曾经是一家书商的店铺。似乎最近还有人用过。

column1: A small hamlet along the road running through the foothills. It was likely once a stopover point for travellers.
column2: 山麓道路旁的一座小村落。从前很可能是旅人的中途歇脚处。

column1: An acrid odour drifts through the thin trees, and in the distance, you can see a pale haze settling.
column2: 一股刺鼻的气味穿过稀疏的树木飘来，远处能看见一层苍白的雾霭沉下来。

column1: This place appears to have been an inn or something similar. The pungent smell of mineral water clings to everything.
column2: 这地方似乎曾经是一家旅店，或类似的所在。矿泉水的刺鼻气味沾在所有东西上。

column1: It is impossible to tell whether you have entered a long-neglected passage covered with fleshy slime, or the bowels of some tremendous, tortured creature.
column2: 你分不清自己走进的是一条久被忽视、覆满肉质黏液的通道，还是某头巨大、饱受折磨的生物的肠腹。

column1: This tunnel appears to go on forever. The walls thrum with the sound of a pulse, and the ground feels as though it is moving beneath your feet.
column2: 这条隧道仿佛没有尽头。墙壁随着脉搏的声音震颤，脚下的地面感觉正在移动。

column1: It looks as though somebody is operating some kind of business out of this old mine. There are a lot of signs of recent activity and a miasma of nonspecific animal odour.
column2: 看起来有人在这座旧矿里经营着某种营生。近期活动的痕迹很多，还有一团说不清是什么动物的气味。

column1: This entire cave has been overtaken with some kind of creeping, fleshy slime. Veins and skin line the walls and ceiling.
column2: 整个洞穴被某种蔓延的肉质黏液占据了。血管和皮肤贴着墙壁和天花板。

column1: Steam rises lazily above this gulch. The air is breathable, but stinks mightily of brimstone.
column2: 蒸汽懒洋洋地从这道沟壑上升起。空气还能呼吸，但硫磺味重得厉害。

column1: A tiny clearing in the forest, barely big enough to start a fire and dry your clothes, but a decent enough place to rest.
column2: 林中一小块空地，勉强够生火烘干衣服，但作为歇脚的地方还算凑合。

column1: A well-built fortress, evidently once held by a respectable lord. Despite its many years of neglect, the structure is still rock-solid.
column2: 一座建造精良的要塞，显然曾由一位体面的领主据守。尽管荒废多年，结构依然坚如磐石。

column1: If this place was ever tranquil, those days are long gone. Now, it is a crumbling facade, a place where the only thing to contemplate is ruin.
column2: 如果这地方曾经宁静过，那样的日子也早已远去。如今它只是一座崩塌的门面，唯一值得凝视的东西就是废墟。

column1: This once-imposing gate is now heavily scabbed with rust and decay.
column2: 这扇曾经气势逼人的门，如今结着厚厚的锈痂和腐迹。

column1: A narrow path slices its way up the side of this cliff face. It's likely to be very dangerous.
column2: 一条窄路沿着这面崖壁向上切开。多半非常危险。

column1: The foul air in this humid tunnel is difficult to breathe. It is difficult to imagine anything living here.
column2: 这条潮湿隧道里的污浊空气难以呼吸。很难想象有什么东西能住在这里。

column1: A long-abandoned church. Part of it has collapsed, now overtaken with some kind of fleshy slime, as though the building is being slowly devoured.
column2: 一座久已废弃的教堂。一部分已经坍塌，如今被某种肉质黏液占据，仿佛整座建筑正在被慢慢吞噬。

column1: A nauseating coil of twisting, fleshy tunnels. Regular, light puffs of air drift methodically throughout, carrying a smell strongly reminiscent of blood.
column2: 一团令人恶心、扭曲的肉质隧道盘绕着。轻而规律的气息有节奏地到处飘动，带着一股很像血的气味。

column1: This must have once been a small jailhouse. There are no other buildings nearby, so it was either a remote holding area, or the best-built building in a long-gone town.
column2: 这里从前一定是一座小监狱。附近没有别的建筑，所以它要么是一处偏远的关押地，要么是一座早已消失的镇子里建得最好的房子。

column1: What was once a major river crossing has been reduced to a few skeletal bridge struts. Perhaps there's still a workable path across.
column2: 曾经的一处主要渡河点，如今只剩下几根骨架似的桥柱。也许还剩一条能走的路可以过去。

column1: The darkness is stifling, and the layout is obviously designed to confuse and disorient you. Whatever is confined within must be very well-worth confining.
column2: 黑暗令人窒息，布局显然是为了把你弄糊涂，让你失去方向。关在里面的东西，一定非常值得被关起来。

column1: This is an impressive fortress, but it is haunted by a peculiar odour.
column2: 这是一座令人印象深刻的要塞，但有一股古怪的气味阴魂不散。

column1: This gate seems strange. It is obviously sturdy, and well-decorated, but it seems as though it was hastily-built, with the pleasantries added as an afterthought.
column2: 这扇门显得奇怪。它显然坚固，装饰也讲究，但好像是仓促建成的，那些体面的点缀是事后才加上的。

column1: Many structures you have seen are in grievous disrepair, but this one seems worse than most. It seems like it could topple in on itself at any moment.
column2: 你见过的许多建筑都破败不堪，但这一座似乎比大多数更糟。它好像随时会自己向内垮塌。

column1: A vast lake of churning fluid stretches out into the darkness. There is a path, but it is not likely to be a fun trip.
column2: 一片翻涌的液体形成的广阔湖面向黑暗中延伸。有一条路，但这趟路多半不会有趣。

column1: This place appears to be some kind of transport hub, but there is a peculiar odour clinging to the air, and a heavy, warm moisture that makes your skin crawl.
column2: 这地方似乎是某种运输枢纽，但空气里黏着一股古怪的气味，还有沉甸甸的温湿水汽，让你直起鸡皮疙瘩。

column1: This appears to be some kind of transport terminal. The buildings are still in excellent shape, but there is a slime-infested tunnel diving into the earth nearby.
column2: 这里似乎是某种运输终点站。建筑状况依然极好，但附近有一条爬满黏液的隧道扎进地里。

column1: This cave is too cluttered to be abandoned, but too orderly to be occupied by mere animals. Something intelligent lives here.
column2: 这个洞穴太杂乱，不像是被抛弃的，但又太有条理，不像只是动物住着。有某种会思考的东西住在这里。

column1: This strong gate has clearly been manufactured, but there are no signs of toolwork on any of the stones.
column2: 这扇坚固的门显然是制造出来的，但任何一块石头上都没有工具加工的痕迹。

column1: From the ground, you can see a white building shining at the top of this daunting cliff face.
column2: 从地面望去，能看见一座白色建筑在这面令人生畏的崖壁顶端发亮。

column1: Calling this town run-down would be an understatement, but the inhabitants are at least attempting to make it livable. You might be able to get some supplies here.
column2: 说这座镇子破败，都算是客气了，但居民至少在努力让它能住人。你也许能在这里搞到一些补给。

column1: Water still flows through this section of aqueduct, a testament to its solid workmanship. Of course, who knows what else might be taking advantage of it?
column2: 水仍然流过这段渡槽，证明它的做工扎实。当然，谁知道还有什么别的东西在利用它？

column1: There is a small shack and a workshop here. Someone clearly lives here.
column2: 这里有一间小棚屋和一座工坊。显然有人住在这儿。

column1: A bridge still crosses over a narrow stretch of river here, as well as the ruins of some sort of small rest stop.
column2: 一座桥仍然跨过这里狭窄的一段河，还有某种小型歇脚站的废墟。

column1: A grand estate looms above the tangled woods. The building is still in reasonably good condition, but there are no signs of recent use.
column2: 一座宏大的庄园耸立在缠结的树林之上。建筑状况还算不错，但没有近期使用的迹象。

column1: This ancient forest temple is collapsed and overgrown, but there is still something serene and beautiful about it.
column2: 这座古老的森林神殿已经坍塌，长满了植物，但依然有某种宁静而美丽的东西。

column1: There is a large farmhouse here that seems to have weathered the years better than most. It might make a decent shelter.
column2: 这里有一座大农舍，似乎比大多数建筑更能经受岁月。也许能当个像样的庇护所。

column1: It looks like once, there was a network of footbridges spanning this section of river, but now there's nothing but rapids. Crossing will be a challenge.
column2: 看起来从前有一张步桥网横跨这段河，如今却只剩下激流。渡过去会是一场挑战。

column1: This was once used by nobles to take scenic tours up the mountainside. Someone has taken great pains to keep it maintained.
column2: 这里曾被贵族用来沿山坡作风景游览。有人费了很大力气维持它。

column1: In every way, this place is the very picture of a wizard's tower. Though it appears to be abandoned, you're likely to find all manner of strangeness inside.
column2: 无论从哪方面看，这地方都是一座巫师塔的典型模样。虽然似乎已被遗弃，你多半会在里面发现各种各样的怪事。

column1: This section of road appears to be well-traveled, even if the forest has grown wild around it.
column2: 这段路似乎常有人走，尽管周围的森林已经疯长开来。

column1: This abbey may be run-down, but what is left of it is obviously still well-tended.
column2: 这座修道院也许破败，但剩下的部分显然仍有人精心照料。

column1: There is a small village here scrapped together from old wood. Whoever built this was not very forward-thinking.
column2: 这里有一座用旧木头拼凑起来的小村子。不管是谁建的，都不怎么有远见。

column1: This manor house is surprisingly well-preserved, as though it has been frozen in time. Strangely, it doesn't appear as though anybody is living here.
column2: 这座庄园出奇地保存完好，仿佛被冻结在时间里。奇怪的是，看上去并没有人住在这里。

column1: The tunnel into the mountain descends for what seems like forever before you finally reach a hollowed-out mining area. The place gives you a strange sense of deja vu.
column2: 进山的隧道仿佛永远向下，你才终于到达一处掏空的采矿区。这地方给你一种奇怪的似曾相识之感。

column1: Once you get past the mouth of the cave, it is evident that you have discovered a storehouse of great wealth. It is undoubtedle a popular target for thieves.
column2: 一过洞口，你就看得出自己发现了一座贮藏巨额财富的库房。它毫无疑问是盗贼们热衷的目标。

column1: This stretch of road along the lakeside is wide open. There are a few small ruined buildings that could be used as shelters for beasts or bandits. Best keep a lookout.
column2: 这段沿湖的路十分开阔。有几座残破的小建筑，野兽或强盗都可能拿来当庇护所。最好留神四周。

column1: This may have once been a road, but the forest has long since reclaimed it. You are barely able to pick out a path through the trees.
column2: 这里也许曾经是一条路，但森林早已把它收回。你几乎辨不出一条穿过树木的路。

column1: Though the mire is generally foul-smelling, this region is particularly consumed of a foul, heavy miasma.
column2: 虽然这片泥沼总体都臭，这一带尤其被一股恶臭、沉甸的瘴气吞没。

column1: This stretch of roadway is soggy and sinking.
column2: 这段路面又湿又在下陷。

column1: This appears to once have been a rural family home, but it has been standing disused for many years.
column2: 这里似乎曾经是一户乡间人家的家，但已经闲置多年。

column1: Shelters like this are often built alongside long stretches of road. They offer shelter for desperate travelers, but also for bandits. Looking inside is a gamble.
column2: 这样的庇护所常常建在漫长路段的旁边。它们给走投无路的旅人提供遮蔽，也给强盗提供遮蔽。往里面看，就是在赌。

column1: There is an inn built into the side of this large hill. It seems unlikely that it would still be operational, but at the very least, the building seems secure.
column2: 这座大山丘的侧面建着一家旅店。它不大可能还在营业，但至少建筑看上去很安全。

column1: Through some miracle, most of this swamp-built shanty town remains above the water.
column2: 靠着某种奇迹，这座建在沼泽上的棚户区大部分仍高出水面。

column1: This may once have been a large village, but it has been burned to the ground. Foundations, ashes, and crumbling stone are all that remain.
column2: 这里也许曾经是一座大村子，但已经被烧成白地。剩下的只有地基、灰烬和崩裂的石头。

column1: An air of uneasiness hangs over this old town. Most of the buildings are still standing, but it doesn't appear that anybody has moved in.
column2: 这座老镇上空悬着一股不安的气息。大多数建筑还立着，但看上去并没有人搬进来。

column1: There is a rough-looking shelter built in the lowest branchest of this gigantic tree. The construction appears to be fairly recent.
column2: 这棵巨树最低的树枝上建着一座看上去粗糙的庇护所。建造时间似乎相当近。

column1: This blackened tower looks like it was once under heavy siege, and it is barely standing. It looks dangerous, but that danger may have deterred looters in the past. Perhaps something valuable remains.
column2: 这座熏黑的塔看上去曾经遭受过猛烈围攻，如今勉强立着。它看起来很危险，但这危险也许曾经吓退过劫掠者。也许还剩着些值钱的东西。

column1: It is obvious that this tomb has been thoroughly plundered and vandalized, and an air of bitter spite hangs heavy over it.
column2: 显然这座墓已经被彻底洗劫并蓄意破坏过，一股辛辣的怨恨沉甸甸地压在它上面。

column1: This place can only have been a palace. Now it is crumbling as the island slowly reclaims it. It is an obvious target for looting, so it is doubtful that much of value remains.
column2: 这地方只能是一座宫殿。如今它正在崩塌，岛屿慢慢把它收回。它是显而易见的洗劫目标，所以不大可能还剩多少值钱的东西。

column1: There is a chilling stillness in the air here, as though even time itself has managed to forget it. Your footsteps on the surprisingly clean floor seem dull and distant.
column2: 这里的空气里有一种彻骨的寂静，仿佛连时间本身都设法把它忘了。你走在干净得令人意外的地板上，脚步声显得沉闷而遥远。

column1: This old archive is holding up fairly well, despite some obvious charring on the outside walls.
column2: 这座旧档案库撑得还算不错，尽管外墙上有明显的烧焦痕迹。

column1: This underground bunker has been damaged badly by many years of moisture and neglect, but it still appears to be sturdy.
column2: 这座地下碉堡被多年的潮湿和荒废严重损坏了，但看上去依然坚固。

column1: This woodland path leads right underneath a tall archway of stone. It looks like a classic ambush location.
column2: 这条林间小径正好从一座高大的石拱门下穿过。看上去是个经典的埋伏地点。

column1: This tunnel was probably once part of a road. There is not much left but mud.
column2: 这条隧道从前大概是一条路的一部分。除了泥，剩下的已经不多了。

column1: A broad path between the water's edge and the forest winds along the rocks here. Visibility is good, but that holds true for creatures lurking nearby as well.
column2: 一条宽路在水边和森林之间，沿着这里的岩石蜿蜒。视野很好，但对潜伏在附近的生物来说也一样。

column1: Even the most untrained can sense that this area is thick with magic. There are many signs of recent activity.
column2: 哪怕最没有受过训练的人也能感觉到，这一带魔力很浓。近期活动的痕迹很多。

column1: This estate, overlooking the slopes of the mountain below, appears to be in excellent condition. It is likely that someone still lives here.
column2: 这座庄园俯瞰着下方的山坡，状况看上去极好。很可能还有人住在这里。

column1: There is a strange villa tucked away in the forest here.
column2: 这里的森林里藏着一座奇怪的别墅。

column1: This otherwise unremarkable forest clearing is choked with a thick smoke, blotting out the sun. Something strange is going on here.
column2: 这片本来毫不起眼的林间空地被浓烟呛住，遮住了太阳。这里正在发生某种怪事。

column1: This appears to be an old brewery, but there are obvious signs that it is still being used.
column2: 这里似乎是一座旧酿酒厂，但有明显的迹象表明它仍在使用。

column1: This road winding through the mountainside appears to veer off in several different directions. It would be a convenient place to set up a shop, or an ambush.
column2: 这条沿山坡蜿蜒的路似乎朝好几个不同的方向岔开。在这里开一家店，或者设一场埋伏，都很方便。

column1: A dilapidated farm along the edge of what was probably once a major road. It looks like there are signs of activity.
column2: 一座破败的农场，坐落在一条大概曾经是大路的路边。看上去有活动的迹象。

column1: This wide-open grassy field is easy travelling, but it leaves you entirely exposed.
column2: 这片开阔的草地走起来很容易，但会让你完全暴露。

column1: There is a tiny roadside shelter here, made to serve as an emergency stop for travelers. Of course, it's anybody's guess what could be in there.
column2: 这里有一座小小的路边庇护所，本是给旅人当紧急歇脚处的。当然，里面可能有什么，谁也说不准。

column1: This farmhouse is sheltered by a copse of trees, and as such, it has held up better than you might expect.
column2: 这座农舍被一小片树丛遮着，因此比你预想的保存得更好。

column1: A strange cabin sits here in a clearing. It almost seems as though the forest is afraid to grow too close to its walls.
column2: 一块空地上坐落着一间奇怪的小屋。森林几乎像是不敢长得离它的墙壁太近。

column1: An uncomfortable sensation permeates this building. It seems to be little more than rubble, but there are signs of frequent and recent use.
column2: 一种不舒服的感觉渗透了这座建筑。它看上去不过是一堆瓦砾，但有频繁且近期使用的迹象。

column1: There are a few old homes and shops huddled together on the cliff face here. Most of the buildings are still in decent condition.
column2: 这里的崖壁上挤着几座旧住宅和店铺。大多数建筑状况还算过得去。

column1: A shoddy commune has been established here. It's in very poor condition, but that appears to be because it was poorly-built, not because it is particularly old.
column2: 这里建起了一座粗劣的公社。状况非常差，但那似乎是因为建得很糟，而不是因为特别老。

column1: This forest trail is littered with young growth, as though it was cleared within the last several years.
column2: 这条林间小径上散落着新生的草木，仿佛是最近几年里才被清开的。

column1: There are recently-constructed huts dotting this coastal trail. There aren't signs of recent usage, however, so whoever built them has probably moved on.
column2: 沿这条海岸小径散布着一些新建不久的棚屋。不过没有近期有人住过的痕迹，所以建造它们的人多半已经离开了。

column1: This old rest stop has a sizeable outdoor eating area. In its day, it was probably a very popular place to get a meal.
column2: 这座老旧的歇脚站有一片相当大的露天用餐区。在它兴盛的时候，这里大概是个很受欢迎的吃饭去处。

column1: There is a hobbled-together cabin nestled into the base of the cliff here. It's quite conspicuous.
column2: 悬崖脚下嵌着一间东拼西凑的小屋。它相当显眼。

column1: Hardly anything remains of this old cabin but for a few rotting boards and beams.
column2: 这间老屋几乎什么都没剩下，只余几块腐烂的木板和梁木。

column1: The entrance to this place is well-disguised, and the interior seems clean and well-kept.
column2: 这里的入口伪装得很好，内部看起来干净整洁。

column1: Somebody went to great lengths to excavate this tunnel and put a vault here. Somebody else evidently went to great lengths to break into it.
column2: 有人费了很大功夫挖出这条隧道，并在这里建了一座金库。显然，另有人也费了很大功夫闯了进去。

column1: This ziggurat climbs high above the treeline, but age and neglect have brought much of it down upon itself.
column2: 这座金字形神塔高耸在树线之上，但岁月与荒废已让它塌了大半，碎块落在自己身上。

column1: There is a well-tended tunnel leading into the mountainside here. It has several heavy barricades blocking it.
column2: 这里有一条养护良好的隧道通向山腹。几道沉重的路障封着它。

column1: There is nothing particularly remarkable about this clearing. It might be a good place to rest up.
column2: 这片空地没什么特别之处。倒也许是个歇脚的好地方。

column1: This collapsed home appears unremarkable at first, but it looks as though there has been recent traffic to and from the basement.
column2: 这栋坍塌的房子乍看平平无奇，但地下室似乎近来有人进进出出。

column1: This building is in excellent condition. Based on the remaining signage, it was once some kind of high-end marketplace. Perhaps something of use remains inside.
column2: 这栋建筑保存极好。从残留的招牌来看，它曾是某种高档市集。也许里面还留着些有用的东西。

column1: An old sewer junction that might provide a way across the water. It hasn't been in active use for many years, so at least you are unlikely to find much in the way of actual sewage.
column2: 一座老旧的下水道交汇处，也许能提供一条渡水的路。它已经很多年没在使用了，所以至少你不太可能碰到多少真正的污水。

column1: Just one more run-down home along a run-down road. At the very least it might provide acceptable shelter for a night.
column2: 破败道路旁又一座破败的房子。起码它也许能凑合一晚的栖身之处。

column1: A small building decorated with macabre carvings juts out of the earth here like an angry fang. There is no obvious way inside.
column2: 一座饰有阴森雕刻的小建筑从地里探出，像一颗愤怒的尖牙。没有明显的入口。

column1: This opulent palace is sorely out of place against the bleak swath of ruin that surrounds it. This Frico must like to make an impression.
column2: 这座奢华的宫殿与周围一片萧瑟的废墟格格不入。这个 Frico 想必很喜欢给人留下印象。

column1: This forest trail is blocked by some kind of crude wooden fortress. It should be simple enough to get inside of it, but there is a perplexing odour coming from behind the walls.
column2: 这条林间小径被某种粗糙的木堡挡住了。进去应该不难，但墙后飘来一股令人费解的气味。

column1: Crumbling remnants of a town on the sea. Many of the buildings are holding up well enough, and there are footprints indicating recent traffic, but they are not the footprints of orcs or men.
column2: 海边一座城镇的残垣。许多建筑还撑得住，也有足迹表明近来有人来往，但那些既不是兽人的脚印，也不是人类的。

column1: A foul, wet air clings to this old sewer tunnel, but with any luck, you'll find a useable passage to the other side.
column2: 一股污浊潮湿的空气贴在这条老下水道隧道里，但运气好的话，你能找到一条通往另一侧的可用通道。

column1: There is a small building here housing what appears to be a sewer access. There's no way to know just what this connects to.
column2: 这里有一座小建筑，里面似乎是一处下水道入口。没法知道它究竟通向哪里。

column1: It looks as if this tunnel connects to a small building up above.
column2: 这条隧道看起来连着上面的一座小建筑。

column1: This forest path is twisted and confusing, and there are no obvious landmarks to follow. Navigating it without some idea of where you're headed promises to be fruitless.
column2: 这条林间小路弯弯绕绕，令人迷惑，也没有明显的地标可循。若不知道自己要去哪里，在这里找路注定一无所获。

column1: Ash and glittering shards of obsidian litter this twisted trail through the Blackglass mountains. Visibility is highly limited.
column2: 灰烬与闪烁的黑曜石碎片撒满了这条穿过黑璃山脉的扭曲小径。能见度非常有限。

column1: This building likely once served as an inspection area for merchants carrying goods along the road. Now, it stands unused, except perhaps as a shelter for occasional travellers.
column2: 这栋建筑很可能曾是检查沿路运货商人的关卡。如今它闲置着，顶多偶尔给过路旅人挡风。

column1: This old mansion is relatively sheltered by the surrounding terrain, and has escaped much damage. Perhaps it has escaped the notice of looters as well.
column2: 这座老宅相对受到周围地形的遮蔽，逃过了大部分损坏。也许它也同样逃过了劫掠者的注意。

column1: This timber fortress appears to have been erected relatively recently. It isn't a perfect shelter against the elements, but it might be acceptable in a pinch.
column2: 这座木堡看起来修建得比较晚。它挡不住全部风吹雨打，但急用时也许还凑合。

column1: This road winds steeply down the side of the mountain, diving into the forest below.
column2: 这条路沿着山坡陡峭盘下，一头扎进下方的森林。

column1: This cave appears to once have been used to house a great deal of people. It might be a good place to hide out.
column2: 这个洞穴看起来曾用来安置大批人。也许是个藏身的好地方。

column1: At first, this building appears to be all but totally demolished, but recent traffic indicates that someone, or something, is still using the basement.
column2: 这座建筑乍看几乎被彻底拆毁，但近期的往来痕迹表明，有什么人——或者什么东西——仍在使用地下室。

column1: This broad cavern has an air of animal stink about it, but it might make a decent shelter if you cleared it out.
column2: 这座宽阔的洞窟里有一股兽腥，但要是清干净，倒能当个像样的遮蔽处。

column1: A small hut sits here amid the dampness of the swamp. It might make an acceptable place to camp for a while, if you could tolerate the moisture and the insects.
column2: 沼泽的潮湿中立着一间小棚屋。要是你受得了湿气和虫子，它也许能凑合着扎营一阵子。

column1: The road here ends abruptly at a stony promontory. Perhaps there was once a structure here, or else a landing for small boats.
column2: 道路在这里戛然止于一处石岬。也许这里曾有建筑，又或者是小船的泊岸。

column1: This weathered lighthouse stands defiant against the grey sky. It has been beaten by many long years of neglect, but it still appears to be sturdy.
column2: 这座饱经风霜的灯塔傲然立在灰暗的天空下。多年荒废把它磨蚀得很厉害，但它看起来依然结实。

column1: This was the cave you washed up in. There's no reason to go back inside that watery deathtrap.
column2: 这就是你被冲上岸的那个洞穴。没有理由再回到那个灌满水的死亡陷阱里。

column1: This old farm looks like it might have once been used to corral animals, and there are hints that it might still see occasional use as a shelter.
column2: 这座老农场看起来曾用来圈养牲畜，而且有迹象表明，它偶尔仍会被当作遮蔽处。

column1: This old mine appears to have been converted into a town of sorts, but it's unclear as to whether anyone is still here.
column2: 这座老矿似乎被改成了某种城镇，但不清楚是否还有人留在这里。

column1: This serene abbey is understated, a classic sign of orcish design. It's small, and looks like it would have been a charming place to have a wedding, back when such things were still practiced on the island.
column2: 这座宁静的修道院风格克制，是典型的兽人式设计。它不大，看起来在岛上还兴办婚礼的年代，会是个举办婚礼的好地方。

column1: An old hunting lodge that was once a favorite retreat of someone named Maxim Spartill, if the signage is to be believed.
column2: 一座古老的狩猎小屋。若招牌所言不虚，它曾是一个叫 Maxim Spartill 的人最爱的静养之处。

column1: A private archive bearing stately and official ornamentation. It looks as though all of the windows have been plastered over, and a dark air hangs heavy over the building.
column2: 一座带着庄重官式装饰的私人档案库。所有窗户似乎都被抹上了灰泥，一股阴沉的气息沉甸甸地罩着这栋建筑。

column1: The portal that carried you to Lord Barrod's castle is now closed, the trip unnervingly fresh in your mind. You can almost still feel his eyes boring through you.
column2: 把你送到领主 Barrod 城堡的传送门如今已经关闭，那段行程却鲜明得令人不安。你几乎还能感到他的目光穿透你。

column1: This appears to be an ancient cemetary. It is small and unremarkable.
column2: 这里看起来是一座古老的墓地。又小，又不起眼。

column1: This old village appears to be entirely empty. There aren't even signs of animal habitation.
column2: 这座老村庄看起来空无一人。甚至没有动物栖居的痕迹。

column1: The marble halls of this exquisite tomb are alive with a tense energy. Something tremendous lurks within.
column2: 这座精美陵墓的大理石厅堂里涌动着紧绷的能量。有什么了不得的东西潜伏其中。

column1: This sheltered clearing still holds the remains of some kind of ceremonial gathering.
column2: 这片有遮蔽的空地仍留着某种仪式集会的残迹。

column1: This might once have been a town, but ramshackle walls have been erected in strange places. Still, perhaps there is shelter to be found.
column2: 这里也许曾是一座城镇，但有人在奇怪的地方立起了摇摇欲坠的墙。尽管如此，也许还能找到遮蔽处。

column1: Even before you see the carnage, you can smell it. Mangled bits of corpsemeat litter the clearing. Whoever it was isn't just dead, they are utterly destroyed.
column2: 还没看见惨状，你就已经闻到了。撕得稀烂的尸块散落在空地上。不管那是谁，都不只是死了，而是被彻底毁掉了。

column1: This appears to be a conveniently-located rest stop for merchants passing through the mountain trail.
column2: 这里看起来是山道过往商人一处位置便利的歇脚站。

column1: The mood about this small congregation is eerie and a little too enthusiastic.
column2: 这一小群人聚在一起的气氛诡异，而且热情得有点过头。

column1: This underground sprawl is a mess of sloppily-erected walls and confusing passages, cluttered with rubble and permeated with a nauseating odour.
column2: 这片地下杂建区乱成一团：墙砌得潦草，通道令人迷惑，瓦砾堆积，还弥漫着一股令人作呕的气味。

column1: This looks like a network of tunnels between nearby basement constructions. It might still be navigable.
column2: 这看起来是附近几处地下室之间的隧道网。也许还能走通。

column1: A large, yawning cavern with multiple exits. It's too large for your light to cover easily, so you can't tell if there's anything inside or not.
column2: 一座巨大而张着口的洞窟，有多个出口。它大得你的光照不太容易覆盖，所以你分不清里面有没有东西。

column1: There is a broad clearing in the marsh vegetation here. It might be an acceptable place to camp, and it is large enough to accomodate a whole group.
column2: 这里的沼泽植被中有一片宽阔的空地。也许能凑合着扎营，而且大得容得下一整队人。

column1: A watchtower juts above the treetops here. It might still be sturdy enough to get a good view of the surrounding terrain.
column2: 一座瞭望塔从树冠之上探出。它也许还够结实，能把周围地形看个清楚。

column1: Tightly-clustered buildings and wooden barricades form a twisted path here. There's no telling what could be lurking behind any particular corner.
column2: 挤在一起的建筑和木路障在这里围出一条弯弯绕绕的路。谁也说不准哪个拐角后面潜伏着什么。

column1: A small, overgrown graveyard, nearly swallowed up by the encroaching wilderness.
column2: 一座杂草丛生的小墓地，几乎要被步步逼近的荒野吞没。

column1: An old home, sheltered by a tall copse of trees.
column2: 一座老宅，掩在一片高高的树丛中。

column1: Perhaps this was once a popular place for travelers to enjoy a night's shelter. Weather, age, and encroaching woodland have destroyed most of it.
column2: 这里也许曾是旅人乐于借宿一夜的地方。风雨、岁月和步步逼近的林地已经毁掉了它的大部分。

column1: There is an old stone bridge still spanning a narrow stretch of the river here. It still appears to be sturdy, despite a collapsed building of similar construction nearby.
column2: 这里有一座老石桥，仍横跨着河面较窄的一段。尽管附近一座同样造法的建筑已经坍塌，桥看起来依然结实。

column1: A small, unassuming home that appears to still be intact. Would make a decent shelter for the night.
column2: 一座不起眼的小房子，看起来还完好。夜里能当个像样的遮蔽处。

column1: There is some kind of shrine or memorial at the centre of a crossroads here. It looks long-neglected, but still serves as a prominent landmark.
column2: 这里的十字路口中央有某种神龛或纪念物。它看起来荒废已久，但仍是一处显眼的地标。

column1: A rough fortress hacked together out of sloppy lumber. It promises to guard against beasts and intruders, if not against the elements.
column2: 一座用劣质木料胡乱拼起来的粗堡。它也许防得住野兽和闯入者，却防不住风吹雨打。

column1: An old brick house tucked away in a forgotten corner of the forest. Perhaps once it lay along a road, now long overgrown.
column2: 森林一处被遗忘的角落里藏着一座老砖房。它也许曾临着一条路，而那条路早已被草木吞没。

column1: This wide plateau is all that's left of what might once have been a town or a trading post, but there is very little rubble remaining, as if the buildings were leveled deliberately.
column2: 这片宽阔的高地，是一座可能曾存在的城镇或贸易站仅剩的一切，但瓦砾所剩无几，仿佛那些建筑是被故意夷平的。

column1: A pass running through a narrow valley. There appear to be multiple routes, and the area is ripe for an ambush.
column2: 一条穿过狭窄山谷的隘口。似乎有多条路线，而这地方正适合埋伏。

column1: This old town has nearly been swallowed by swelling tides. There might still be useable salvage, or at the very least useable shelter.
column2: 这座老镇几乎被上涨的潮水吞没。也许还能找到能用的残货，起码还有能用的遮蔽处。

column1: This old collection of homes might once have housed the families of shipbuilders.
column2: 这一片老房子也许曾住着造船匠的家眷。

column1: There is a faint path twisting through the thick woodland here. It is difficult to see very far ahead.
column2: 这里有一条淡淡的小路在浓密的林地里蜿蜒。很难看清前方多远。

column1: The remains of this grand highroad are still in excellent condition. Visibility is very clear, but this could also be a detriment.
column2: 这条宏伟大道的遗迹状况依然极好。视野非常开阔，但这也可能是个坏处。

column1: There's a hut by the edge of a small pond here. It seems out of place in such a harsh stretch of terrain.
column2: 这里的小池塘边有一间棚屋。在这么荒凉的地段里，它显得格格不入。

column1: It looks as though a shelter was built partway into an existing cave in the mountainside here.
column2: 看起来有人把一处遮蔽所修进了这边山腹里一座现成的洞穴。

column1: An almost palpable darkness hangs in a heavy cloud around the grounds of this old mansion. There is no sign of life or activity of any kind.
column2: 几乎伸手可触的黑暗像厚重的云团罩着这座老宅的庭院。没有任何生命或活动的迹象。

column1: This tower looks to have once been used for receiving and processing cargo by sea. It is built partway into the side of the cliff overlooking the water.
column2: 这座塔看起来曾用来接收和处理海运货物。它有一半嵌进俯瞰水面的悬崖侧面。

column1: A dark chasm. Who knows how far down it goes?
column2: 一道黑暗的裂隙。谁知道它有多深？

column1: An old guard post along the road. It appears to be in good shape, so it may still have supplies inside if you can find a way in.
column2: 路边一座老岗哨。它看起来状况不错，所以你要是能找到进去的办法，里面也许还有补给。

column1: An old ferry station. The current is far too dangerous to attempt swimming, but you might be able to find some way to get the ferry working.
column2: 一座老渡口。水流凶险，绝不能下水游过去，但你也许能想办法让渡船重新开动。

column1: This building looks to have been a roadside tavern once, possibly catering to sailors. Like everything else here, it is fallen into disrepair and overgrown.
column2: 这栋建筑看起来曾是路边酒馆，也许是招待水手的。和这里的一切一样，它已经破败，长满了荒草。

column1: This road must have once been a major thoroughfare into the caldera. An old tolling station sits here, crumbling alongside the road.
column2: 这条路想必曾是进入破火山口的一条大干道。一座老收费站坐落在这里，顺着道路一同崩坏。

column1: This section of the city appears to have been a sprawl of old workshops and storefronts. It seems unlikely that any of them will still be open for business.
column2: 城区的这一片看起来曾是老作坊和店面铺开的一片。它们不太可能还有哪家在营业。

column1: A lonely cliff overlooking the rocky coast below. There are a number of memorial tokens in the area, hinting at the area's history.
column2: 一座孤零零的悬崖，俯瞰下方的岩岸。这一带有不少纪念信物，暗示着这里的过往。

column1: This old courthouse has held up well over the years. It still retains an air of menacing authority.
column2: 这座老法院这些年来保存得不错。它仍带着一种森然的权威气派。

column1: An old monastery, solemnly crumbling into a dignified pile of rubble.
column2: 一座古老的隐修院，庄严地崩成一堆仍不失尊严的瓦砾。

column1: An old prison on a cliff overlooking the sea. It could make a decent shelter for the evening, but it is far too cramped to serve as a stronghold.
column2: 悬崖上俯瞰大海的一座老监狱。晚上能当个像样的遮蔽处，但太过狭促，当不了据点。

column1: An old one-room schoolhouse. It has held up surprisingly well. You can almost still hear the voices of schoolchildren singing.
column2: 一座只有一间教室的老校舍。它保存得出奇地好。你几乎还能听见学童唱歌的声音。

column1: This old walled garden has been mostly overrun with weeds, but it might still make a decent camp, provided you don't mind an open sky overhead.
column2: 这座有围墙的老花园大半已被杂草占领，但要是你不介意头顶一片开阔的天空，它也许仍能当个像样的营地。

column1: This crumbling structure appears to be an ancient house of worship, but it seems long-abandoned.
column2: 这栋崩坏的建筑看起来是一座古老的礼拜堂，但似乎早已废弃。

column1: This old fortress is barely more than a shell, but it seems sturdy, and it is large enough to shelter a small army.
column2: 这座老要塞几乎只剩一个空壳，但它看起来结实，而且大得容得下一支小军队。

column1: A chill air flows from this place, and when you peek inside you are greeted with the sight of a temple formed of ice, worked and carved as if it were stone.
column2: 一股寒气从这里流出。你往里一瞥，迎面看见一座由冰筑成的神殿，被人像加工石料那样雕琢过。

column1: This ancient barn-like structure is well-sheltered from the weather by surrounding terrain, and easily large enough to house dozens of people.
column2: 这座古老的仓房式建筑因周围地形而很好地避开了风雨，而且轻松容得下几十人。

column1: This shrine has a lot of information about the basics of magic and combat effects.
column2: 这座神龛里有许多关于魔法基础和战斗效果的资料。

column1: This shack is leaning to the left a little, but it seems otherwise sturdy. The terrain, however, is very rough, and the area wouldn't be suitable for use as a stronghold.
column2: 这间棚屋有点向左倾斜，但除此之外似乎还结实。不过地形非常崎岖，这一带不适合用作据点。

column1: This building looks like it used to be some kind of military outpost, but it's in shambles, and would be worthless as a stronghold. A nearby gatehouse might offer decent shelter for a night, at the very least.
column2: 这栋建筑看起来曾是某种军事哨站，但已成废墟，当据点毫无价值。附近的门楼起码也许能提供一夜像样的遮蔽。

column1: A footpath through a soggy marshland. You might be able to camp here short-term, but it is not large enough or safe enough for your whole band.
column2: 一条穿过湿软沼泽的小径。你也许能在这里短期扎营，但它不够大，也不够安全，容不下你的整个团伙。
